Jots About Us 👋 Blog Log in Sign up What's new Just shipped v2025.12.19 Critical thinking for developers who want to stay irreplaceable. In this age of generative AI, critical thinking is no longer optional, it’s a competitive advantage. Backed by research, Jots helps you sharpen your reflection skills to become a smarter dev and outperform your peers. Get started for free! Beta Version 15 Minutes Per Day To Set Yourself Apart A Harvard Business School study found that workers who spent only 15 minutes a day reflecting on their work improved their work performance by ~23% over 10 days. “We do not learn from experience… we learn from reflecting on experience.” — John Dewey (educational reformer) Built To Help You Think Better Jots is a thinking system designed to improve your critical thinking, guide your reflection, and turn your experience into measurable progress. Capture Thoughts Without Friction A fast, free-form journaling editor that gets ideas out of your head before they disappear. Light AI assistance helps you rephrase, clarify, and explore — without taking over your thinking. Think Deeper With Guided Prompts Quick prompts and reflection templates steer your thinking when you don’t know where to start — helping you spot blind spots, patterns, and missed learnings. Close the Loop With Intentional Action Turn reflection into concrete next steps with lightweight tasks. Thinking is only useful when it leads to action. See How Your Thinking Evolves A growth dashboard analyzes how you reflect over time and surfaces insights on clarity, consistency, and depth — so you improve how you think, not just what you do. Build a Feedback Loop for Your Mind Your weekly digest summarizes what happened, highlights progress, and gives you focused pointers for the week ahead — so learning compounds instead of resetting every Monday. Integrate With Your Daily Workflow Reflect where you already work by integrating directly with tools including GitHub and VS Code. How It Works Simple by design. Compounding over time. 01 Capture reflections as you work Choose how you reflect - from guided prompts and templates to journaling. 02 Receive structured feedback Get clear signals on clarity, depth, and growth patterns over time. 03 Review and improve consistently Turn reflection into a habit through weekly summaries and feedback loops. Ready To Improve Your Critical Thinking? Try for free now! Stay in the loop Get updates on our latest features, dev tips and news. And also exclusive perks through early access. Subscribe Psssst... We also maintain an open-source library of journaling prompts 🤓 Contributions welcome. The operations layer that captures your work as you do it. CLI and browser share one context. The report builds itself. Subscribe to HackFast+ Create a project Encrypted at rest CLI-connected Living workspace HackFast platform Live surface Choose a lane Explore 👇 Browse the stack like a preview deck — hover for depth, tap to drill in. 01 Shadow Sessions Stream shell output into the browser, attached to the project 02 Attack Surface Mapper Hosts, ports, services—structured, not spreadsheet soup 03 Fusion Terminal Describe the objective; the CLI agent executes it 04 Jobs & running work Queued objectives, live status, nothing “lost in terminal” 05 People Mapper Orgs, roles, identities—mapped to the engagement 06 CredCruncher Credential intelligence against breach-sized datasets 07 Leak & exposure signals Spot relevant leaks without leaving project context 08 OSINT Map Geographic and relational OSINT in one canvas 09 Attack chains & planning Structured steps, expected results, reusable playbooks 10 Smart Notes Notes that know which host, person, or credential they belong to 11 Live Report Builder The deliverable grows while you hack 12 Endpoint analysis Deep dive routes and API behaviour from the project 13 API tracker Discover and catalogue API surface as you work Content HackFast in Action Short demos and walkthroughs from the field — recon, agents, and reporting in real engagements. Watch on Instagram Watch on Instagram Watch on Instagram Watch on Instagram Take a closer look The bottleneck is not skill. It is workflow. Pentesters lose 20–60% of engagement time to reporting. The deliverable is a document, so senior operators get pulled out of the target and into admin. Cyver Core 2024, Black Hills Report writing Disconnected notes Terminal vs dashboard OSINT as separate job Stale reports Credential chaos Recon sprawl Team hand-offs Evidence management No attack roadmap Report writing Pentesters lose 20–60% of engagement time to reporting. The deliverable is a document, so senior operators get pulled out of the target and into admin. Cyver Core 2024, Black Hills Disconnected notes Teams bounce between CherryTree, Obsidian, text files, and Slack. The missing piece is note-taking that stays attached to the IP, port, person, or output it came from. TCM Security, TrustedSec Terminal vs dashboard The browser knows one thing, the shell knows another, the report something else. Work gets pasted between tabs instead of preserved in one context. Aikido, Pentera OSINT as separate job People, companies, leaks, and infrastructure live across six or more tools with manual correlation. Valuable data exists — making it actionable is slow. CovertSwarm, Redbot Security Stale reports Environments change faster than reporting cycles. Static PDFs arrive after the context has shifted — findings lose value before remediation starts. Horizon3.ai, Kaseya Credential chaos Discovered passwords, API keys, and tokens get dumped into text files with no link back to the host or person they came from. Re-use paths stay invisible until someone manually correlates them. Verizon DBIR, Mandiant Recon sprawl Nmap, Shodan, Amass, subfinder — each tool outputs a different format. Without a single source of truth, operators re-scan targets they already mapped or miss assets entirely. SANS, OffSec Team hand-offs When one tester finishes a phase and passes to another, context lives in someone's head. Onboarding a teammate mid-engagement means hours of catch-up calls instead of a shared workspace. Bishop Fox, NCC Group Evidence management Screenshots, terminal logs, and PoC scripts scatter across local folders and cloud drives. When it's time to write findings, operators waste hours hunting down proof they already captured. Bugcrowd, HackerOne No attack roadmap Most engagements start with a mental checklist. Complex attack chains stay in the tester's head — hard to share, easy to forget, impossible to reproduce for the next assessment. PTES, OWASP Integrations One layer instead of scattered tabs The tools you rely on, the context stays intact. Live integrations 3rd-party workflow context HackFast handles the glue work so your attention stays on the target. See what connects Active usage signal Users relying on HackFast in active engagements right now. 500+ + 496 Fusion Intelligence Point. Your agent does the rest. Connect an agent to any machine. Trigger a scan from the browser. Open ports and IPs land on your attack surface automatically. Recon, CLI, OSINT, credentials, notes, and reporting live in one encrypted workspace. The project keeps the thread. AI with context Fusion plans against real project state, not isolated prompts. Evidence-first reports Findings attach to what supports them, building as you work. Continuous view A living workspace before any PDF is exported. Every phase From target assigned to report delivered The operational layer the rest of the workflow plugs into. 01 Recon Pipe Nmap and scan output into a live attack-surface workspace that structures hosts, ports, and services without spreadsheet cleanup. live output $ nmap -sV -sC 10.0.0.0/24 ✓ 22 open (ssh) ✓ 80 open (http) ✓ 445 open (smb) Recon Built for operators For people who need their work to stay sharp Limited engagement time split across testing, evidence, and delivery. evidence.description: Piny is a powerful visual editor for Astro, React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Edit code visually, navigate components, and streamline styling with no special libraries or extra setup.
evidence.text: Piny – Visual Editor for Astro, React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS Piny Open main menu Features Pricing FAQ Docs Piny Close menu Features Pricing FAQ Docs // Simple mobile menu toggle document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { const openButton = document.getElementById('open-menu-button'); const closeButton = document.getElementById('close-menu-button'); const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu'); const menuBackdrop = document.getElementById('menu-backdrop'); const menuPanel = document.getElementById('menu-panel'); // Add opacity classes for animation menuBackdrop.classList.add('opacity-0'); menuPanel.classList.add('opacity-0'); openButton.addEventListener('click', function() { mobileMenu.classList.remove('hidden'); // Trigger animation after a small delay setTimeout(function() { menuBackdrop.classList.remove('opacity-0'); menuPanel.classList.remove('opacity-0'); }, 10); }); function closeMenu() { menuBackdrop.classList.add('opacity-0'); menuPanel.classList.add('opacity-0'); // Hide the menu after the animation completes setTimeout(function() { mobileMenu.classList.add('hidden'); }, 300); } closeButton.addEventListener('click', closeMenu); menuBackdrop.addEventListener('click', closeMenu); }); Sale — 35% OFF Piny Pro edition Piny – Visual editor for Astro, React, Next.js & Tailwind that runs in your IDE Visual Studio Code Piny is built for developers who care about speed and staying in control. All edits happen directly in your code. Use Piny alongside your favorite coding assistant—or on its own. Compatible with any React or Next.js project. Use it for free Upgrade to Pro → 🎉 Guide – Learn how you can use Piny with Lovable Want to see more? Watch the Getting Started video (15 min) Matjaz, creator of Piny document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { const playButton = document.getElementById('play-button'); const videoContainer = document.getElementById('video-container'); const heroImage = document.getElementById('hero-image'); const iframe = document.getElementById('youtube-iframe'); const heroImg = heroImage.querySelector('img'); playButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); videoContainer.classList.remove('hidden'); player = new YT.Player('video-container', { height: '360', width: '640', videoId: 'f1HIqDKx1sE', playerVars: { rel: 0 }, events: { onReady: function(event) { event.target.playVideo(); } } }); //heroImage.classList.add('hidden'); }); }); Why Piny? Enjoy powerful free features for styling and navigating your project – no account needed. Visual Tailwind Controls Click on any element in your code to style it with intuitive visual controls. Changes are immediatelly reflected in the code. The document is automatically saved to trigger the hot reload. FREE Tailwind Class Inspector Manage complex Tailwind styles, neatly organized in an editable tree of classes and states. FREE Edit Tailwind Classes Everywhere Edit Tailwind classes directly within strings, variables, and even in non-React/Astro code. FREE Component Navigation Quickly jump between components – in Piny and in the code. Associate routes with individual components to always get the relevant preview. FREE AI Powered Drag & Drop Quickly build your UI visually using AI-assisted drag and drop. Use built-in AI Assistat with your own API provider key. Piny works alongside your favorite AI agent. FREE Want even more? Unlock  pro features to visually navigate your project and customize Tailwind controls. Visual Select Select elements visually and drill down the components directly from the preview. PRO Edit Multiple Elements at the Same Time Select multiple elements with CMD/CTRL + Click. Use SHIFT + Click to select a range of elements. Then style them with Visual controls and Inspector. PRO Navigate the Whole Project Easily explore and navigate components across your entire project from a single interface. PRO Import Your Custom Tailwind Theme Customize visual controls with your own Tailwind configuration including colors, fonts, and spacing. PRO Getting Started Start using Piny in just two simple steps Install Piny extension and start visually editing your project – without signing up, without changing your code. It is that simple.  Piny works with Astro, React, or Next.js projects. For static HTML or WordPress, use Pinegrow Web Editor instead. Learn more Install Piny extension Install Piny directly from the extension marketplace for your preferred IDE. Open VS Code Marketplace Start Editing Right-click anywhere in your code and select "Edit in Piny" to begin styling with visual controls. duration. Duration is a consumer technology lab. We believe the next wave of consumer experiences will be vastly different to those of today. As consumer hardware continues to evolve, software will exist across multiple surfaces, where visual, text and audio are interoperable. Users will be able to interact with products using any modality they choose, whenever they want. To make this future possible, the cost structure of AI has to fundamentally change. Every generational consumer product has taken a previously impossible creative capability and made it free for everyone. This isn't possible today for AI-native experiences, because AI inference is many orders of magnitude more expensive than traditional software. Therefore, to make consumer AI free at scale, marginal inference costs must be driven to zero. Duration exists to build towards this, with two areas of focus: Applied AI Research: exploring how multi-modal experiences can be delivered at zero incremental cost through on-device inference. Product: building the consumer products on that research, creating experiences that couldn't exist before. This structure creates a flywheel: data and evaluations from our products accelerate our research, and our in-house models and breakthroughs let us build products no one else can. Jadebook - Discover Your True Self {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebSite","name":"Jadebook","url":"https://jadebook.app"} {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Organization","logo":"https://jadebook.app/logo.png","name":"Jadebook","sameAs":["https://x.com/JadebookJournal","https://linkedin.com/company/jadebook"],"url":"https://jadebook.app"} {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"SoftwareApplication","applicationCategory":"HealthApplication","name":"Jadebook","offers":{"@type":"Offer","price":"10.00","priceCurrency":"USD"},"operatingSystem":"Web"} Jadebook Pricing About Blog Get Started Untangle your mind. Reclaim your agency. Stop living in the noise. Jadebook is a secure, solo-developed sanctuary where you can dump your thoughts, track your evolution, and use context-aware AI to see the patterns you’re too close to see. Get Started base elegant ghibli nature sunset Your thoughts aren't a product. In an age of data-mining and corporate committees, Jadebook is an independent fortress. No shareholders, no tracking—just a tool built by one person for people who value their digital sovereignty. Theming A tool that fits your brain. Most apps force you into their aesthetic. Jadebook lets you rebuild the interface—colors, fonts, and layouts—to match your mental state. Tags Structure on your own terms. High-fidelity tagging with custom icons and colors lets you map out your life’s themes without the friction of complex databases. Open-source support If you don't want your data on our servers, host it on yours. We provide an OSS version because we believe your internal world should belong to you alone. A place for every kind of thought. Write deeply when you need room to reflect, or capture a passing thought before it disappears. Journals (Reflection) Start with a guided framework when you need direction, or open a blank page and let your thoughts lead. Guided or freeform Reflection Make room for what matters. Notions (Quick Capture) Save ideas, quotes, and observations in seconds. Keep them close without interrupting the moment. 2 days ago Notions are dumps of ideas that are meant to be short, quick and easy. Perhaps an interesting quote, quick observation or an idea you'd like to explore later. Meet your digital mirror. AI shouldn’t write your journal for you. It should help you read between the lines. Completely optional, entirely private, and powered by Zero-Data-Retention (ZDR). Personal Prompts Move beyond generic questions. Jadebook creates thoughtful prompts from your recent entries, chosen context, and recurring themes. Based on your personality Describe the most meaningful conversation you could have with your younger self. Context-Aware Chat Consult your past self. Chat with an AI that has read your entries. Ask it: "What was I worried about six months ago?" or "Help me see the pattern in my last ten entries." Let’s go through my recent thoughts on... Journals and Notions Deep Insights (Psychological Profile) See the pattern. Automatically extract your OCEAN traits, MBTI profile, and recurring themes. Stop guessing who you are and start seeing the data behind your character evolution. You choose which entries are included in the analysis, giving you full control over what data is used. OCEAN Traits A more comprehensive breakdown of your personality based on the OCEAN framework. Openness 85 Conscientiousness 65 Extraversion 75 Agreeableness 85 Neuroticism 45 Simple, Transparent, Sovereign. We don't have an "Exit Strategy" or venture capital to pay back. We just want to build the best growth tool on the planet. You can also choose to host a self-hosted version of Jadebook. Free $0 All the core features Data synced between devices Unlimited entries AES-256 encryption 20 AI credits every 30 days Pro $10 Higher limits for all content Upload files Advanced AI features More AI credits Share entries Try experimental features FAQ Frequently asked questions about Jadebook. Who is behind Jadebook? Jadebook is a solo developer project. It's not funded by anyone and is meant to be self-sustainable. It's been in the works for around a year since we want to make sure it's a reliable product. What about privacy concerns? Why no annual or forever plans? How does AI usage work for pro users? When is the mobile app coming? Clear the Fog. A modern sanctuary for the independent mind. Find your signal in a world designed to keep you distracted. Join Jadebook Built for clarity, not for clicks. Aquin Labs aq Developer environment for foundation models Aquin Labs Research Changelog Resources Get aq Policies & licensing Terms of Service Privacy Policy Software License Acceptable Use Policy Security & Responsible Disclosure Work with us Environments, libraries and frameworks for foundation models. We're an AI research lab for foundation models. We reverse engineer, interpret and build environments, libraries and frameworks. Our dream is to accelerate ML development with precision and intent for all, enabling safer and better ML across physics, life sciences, industrial, frontier and critical verticals. Backed by awesome programs. Emergent Ventures Founders Inc The Residency NVIDIA Inception Emergent Ventures Founders Inc The Residency NVIDIA Inception Emergent Ventures Founders Inc The Residency NVIDIA Inception Emergent Ventures Founders Inc The Residency NVIDIA Inception We're heading towards a future where foundation models play a significant role across physics, life sciences, industrial, and frontier verticals, and it's critical we find ways to develop and train them better and safer. We're building aq, developer environment for foundation models built with frameworks, libraries, tools and autonomous agents helping design, test, and refine models. aq is built for precision and intent. Think Next.js for JS, but for ML, handling architectural, experiments, and building AI the way it should be built, deliberately, not by guessing. $ curl -fsSL https://aq.aquin.app/framework/install.sh | bash aq Login LAION Building an interpretable VLM that maps text and vision towers on top of OpenCLIP. Learn more KAIST Using interpretability tooling for preference detection analysis in LLMs. Learn more AEIA Lab Training SAEs on a LLM to sense conflict, ambiguity, and tone, and choose the right response. Zyogen Building interpretable medical vision transformers and diffusion models. Learn more What labs build with aq Training a ViT on wound recovery imaging, then interpreting it to distill a prediction system. Finding features that drive recovery signals, then building and distilling leaner predictor to be able to inspect. Learn more Mapping correlations between the human brain and LLM neural nets. Building a testbed for drugs and cures aimed at Alzheimer's, dementia, and schizophrenia. Learn more Finding deceptive features for AI safety. Locating and studying deceptive features before they become failure modes for AI safety. Learn more Finding if models have mechanistic representation of their context exhaustion. What happens inside when a model knows the window is ending, when it knows it is about to die. Learn more Interpreting and quantizing world models. Reading how a model represents the world, then compressing that structure so it stays inspectable and usable. Learn more What researchers are solving with aq We work with frontier labs, research groups, universities, and companies training their own models, from classical ML to foundation models and everything in between. 01 101 011 111 0111 00 0011 input tokens multi-head attention feed-forward output transformers 01 101 111 0111 00 0011 W frozen A rank-r B rank-r lora Not sure if Aquin is right for you? Create smart shopping lists from your saved recipes or manually add items. Transform any recipe into healthier, vegetarian, or vegan versions while maintaining delicious flavors. Save your favorite recipes and access them anytime. Master techniques like air frying, slow cooking, BBQ, and 15-minute meals with specialized templates. Join thousands of home cooks revolutionizing their kitchen with AI-powered assistance. High Attrition Rates Constant churn means managers spend all their time onboarding instead of optimizing high-value customer interactions. No — and it isn't trying to replace yours. An LMS delivers content and tracks completion. UpTroop is a readiness layer that sits alongside it: it turns your existing SOPs, playbooks and product content into daily voice-based practice, then measures whether your team can actually perform in a real conversation — not whether they clicked "complete." LMS = knowledge. UpTroop = execution. How do frontline employees access it? What if they don't have laptops or official email IDs? No laptops, no email IDs, no app downloads required. Learners access UpTroop through WhatsApp on their own phones — they receive a practice nudge, or a role play nudge -they tap the link, verify with an OTP, and start practicing. The whole login takes under 10 seconds. Teams that prefer Microsoft Teams; Slack or a Mobile App can use those instead. Which languages are supported today? 11+ languages are live in production today, including English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali and Kannada — with more rolling out on a defined roadmap. This is native, voice-first practice with localized nuance in each language — not machine-translated text. Learners can switch language themselves, and each language has its own AI coach voice. Will frontline teams actually use it? This is the question we obsess over, because adoption — not content — is where most training fails. UpTroop practice is 3–5 minutes a day, arrives inside WhatsApp where your teams already are, and gives instant feedback that's genuinely useful — so it builds a habit rather than a compliance chore. In our current enterprise deployment, thousands of frontline users engage daily, and users have started practicing in languages ahead of their official rollout — on their own. How is readiness measured? Every practice response and role play is evaluated against the behaviors that matter for the role — objection handling, need discovery, compliance language, empathy, clarity. Each learner gets a Readiness Score with a skill-by-skill breakdown, and leaders see dashboards showing who is ready, where teams struggle, and how readiness is improving over time — at individual, cohort and organization level. You track capability, not completion. Does this improve real performance, or just scores? 90-day pilot deployments have shown 37% faster ramp to productivity, 3x speed to proficiency, and measurable gains in customer satisfaction. Because practice scenarios are built from your real customer situations — the exact objections, hesitations and compliance moments your team faces — improvement in practice translates directly to improvement on the ground. What roles and teams is UpTroop built for?" UpTroop is built for frontline, customer-facing teams — field sales, branch staff, telecalling, collections, and customer service. Practice scenarios are tailored by role, level and outcome: a relationship manager practices lead conversion and objection handling, a collections agent practices difficult payment conversations, a service agent practices de-escalation and resolution. If your team talks to customers, there's a readiness journey for them. Can scenarios be customized to our products, SOPs and real situations? Yes — that's the core of how UpTroop works. Upload your SOPs, product documents, sales scripts or compliance manuals, and the platform converts them into practice scenarios and role plays built on your actual customer situations — your products, your objections, your policies. Your team doesn't practice generic conversations; they practice the exact moments they'll face tomorrow. Your content team can create, review and update scenarios themselves, without depending on us. Does it work for compliance-sensitive conversations? Yes — and this is where practice matters most. In regulated industries, what your team says isn't just a sales skill, it's a compliance obligation. UpTroop scenarios can be built around your compliance requirements — mandatory disclosures, prohibited statements, process adherence — and every practice response is evaluated against them. Instead of discovering compliance gaps in an audit or a customer complaint, you see them in a readiness dashboard and fix them in practice, where mistakes are free. Practice arrives inside WhatsApp, where your teams already are — no new app, no logins to remember, no training on the training tool. Sessions are 3–5 minutes and role-specific, so they fit into a frontline day instead of competing with it. That's the difference between a habit and a compliance chore. For admins, everything — content, users, cohorts, reports — is managed from a single console. What visibility do we get into adoption and readiness? Full visibility, daily. Leaders and L&D see who is engaging, who is ready, and where teams struggle — at individual, cohort and organization level. Reports cover engagement, completion, readiness scores with skill-level breakdowns, and improvement trends over time, all filterable by region, role or team and exportable for your own analysis. You're never managing a rollout blind: the dashboard tells you exactly where adoption needs a push and which learners need human attention. How does pricing work? Enterprise pricing has two components: a per-licence subscription for your active users, and AI consumption units that cover AI-powered activities like role plays, video generation and coaching feedback. This keeps pricing aligned to actual usage rather than a flat fee for shelfware. We'll walk you through a sizing estimate for your team in the first conversation — no surprises later. Can I start with a pilot before committing to a larger rollout? Yes — most clients start with a 90-day pilot: a defined cohort, agreed success metrics, and a clear expansion path if the metrics are met. Pilots run on the full platform, not a demo version, so what you evaluate is exactly what you'd scale. Our published outcome numbers — 37% faster ramp, 3x speed to proficiency — come from pilots structured this way. Can UpTroop integrate with our SSO, HRMS, LMS or other systems? Yes. SSO login, HRMS-driven user provisioning, LMS interoperability and reporting APIs are supported as enterprise integrations, scoped during onboarding based on your systems and requirements. Out of the box, UpTroop also works fully standalone — bulk user upload, OTP login, downloadable reports — so you can launch in days and add integrations as a second phase rather than making them a launch dependency. Can we brand it as our own? Yes. UpTroop supports white-labeling for enterprise clients — your name, your branding, your AI coach persona. Several clients run UpTroop internally under their own program identity, so learners experience it as their company's own readiness platform rather than a third-party tool. What does onboarding involve, and what do you need from us? A structured joint plan: we set up your enterprise environment, train your platform admins, and support content preparation; your side confirms the rollout cohort, shares the user list, and completes IT approvals (whitelisting, security review, WhatsApp business access). (powered by node-llama-cpp ) Metal CUDA Vulkan Complete Data Privacy Your commands, context, and data never leave your device. Perfect for handling sensitive information or working in regulated environments. No Account Required No need to create an account or sign in. Just install and start typing. Memory BashBuddy will remember your past interactions and preferences, learning from your usage patterns to provide increasingly personalized command suggestions over time. Coming Soon Integrations BashBuddy won't just be a CLI tool. It will seamlessly integrate with your favorite tools like Raycast, tmux, Warp, and more. Coming Soon Agent Mode BashBuddy will intelligently determine extra steps to provide better solutions to your questions, handling complex workflows and multi-step processes automatically. evidence.title: purpal - Cursor for Product Teams
evidence.description: An autonomous PM agent that ingests customer signals, drafts specs, and hands off to engineering - so you make decisions, not documents.
evidence.text:
purpal - Cursor for Product Teams (function() { try { var stored = localStorage.getItem('theme'); if (stored === 'dark' || (!stored && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)) { document.documentElement.classList.add('dark'); } else { document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark'); } } catch(e) {} })(); purpal Get early access AI can build software. But it can't decide what to build. purpal is an autonomous PM agent. It ingests customer signals, detects patterns, drafts specs, and hands off to your engineering team — so you focus on what to build, not on building the case for it. Join the waitlist Connects to where your signals live Intercom Jira Linear CSV AI coding agents are fast. But they still need someone to tell them what to build. Customer complaints pile up in Intercom. Feature requests live in spreadsheets. What customers said on calls never makes it into the ticket. PMs spend their days assembling documents instead of making product decisions. purpal does the assembly. You make the calls. Your autonomous PM team. purpal's agents work around the clock - ingesting signals, theming patterns, and drafting specs so you review instead of write: Signal detection Ingests customer conversations, themes patterns, and surfaces what matters before you ask. Spec drafting Generates PRDs, UX briefs, engineering tickets, and tracking plans from real evidence. Quality validation Catches missing metrics, uncited claims, and gaps before engineering sees it. Delivery handoff Pushes validated specs to Jira or Linear, or exposes them to coding agents via API. From raw signals to engineering ready specs. purpal's agents turn scattered customer feedback into validated, structured specs - automatically. Before Z Zoom · Product sync · 47:23 “...they need faster search but also mentioned wanting filters, and then the PM from Enterprise jumped in about sorting...” — Who owns this? No action item created. S Slack · #product-requests · 14 replies @channel can we also add sorting? The PM from Enterprise asked for it yesterday. Also @design is the search bar moving? 3 different threads. No resolution. A Analytics · Search funnel Abandonment 34% Filter usage 12% Bounce rate 67% N Note · Q3 planning PRIORITY: Fix search!! But also Jane said filters are more important? After Smart Search Enhancement Problem Users abandon search due to lack of filtering, causing 34% drop-off and 67% bounce on results pages. Requirements Faceted search with category filters Real-time suggestions (<200ms) Sort by relevance, date, popularity User Story “As a power user, I want to filter results by category so I can find relevant items faster.” Acceptance Criteria – Results update within 200ms – Filters persist across sessions – Mobile responsive, 44px+ touch targets Cursor solved “how to build.” purpal solves “what to build.” AI coding tools ship features in hours. But they still need clear requirements. When specs are wrong, you don’t just waste time — you ship the wrong thing faster. The PM’s role isn’t document assembly. It’s decision-making. purpal handles the assembly so you can focus on the decisions that matter. Specs that humans and AI can ship from. Every spec is structured for your engineering team and machine-readable for coding agents. No guesswork. No rewriting. For humans PMs review and approve instead of writing from scratch. Engineers get tickets with real acceptance criteria. Every claim is cited with evidence or flagged as an assumption. For AI agents Strict JSON output coding agents can consume directly. Acceptance criteria structured for automated testing. API + MCP access for seamless agent-to-agent handoff. How it works From customer pain to a validated, engineering ready spec - autonomously. Step 1 Connect your signals Connect Intercom, upload a CSV, or pipe in signals from any source. purpal's agents theme themes, detect urgency, and surface the issues that matter most. Step 2 Review, don't write Autonomous agents draft complete specs - PRD, engineering tickets with acceptance criteria, tracking plans, and an evidence ledger. You refine and approve. Step 3 Ship with confidence The validator catches gaps before engineering sees it. When you're ready, push to Jira or Linear - or hand off to coding agents 0 autonomous agents working for you 0% of claims cited or flagged 0 blank-page specs to write Built for PMs who ship, not PMs who write. Good fit ✓ You spend more time assembling docs than making decisions. ✓ Your team uses AI coding tools and needs better inputs. ✓ You ship weekly and can’t afford building the wrong thing. ✓ You want customer evidence behind every feature, not gut feel. Not a fit × You prefer to figure requirements out in code. × Your team doesn’t have a PM or product function. × You’re happy writing specs from scratch every time. Stop writing specs. Start making decisions. purpal is launching soon. Join the waitlist to be among the first PMs with an autonomous product team. I literally take a photo of whatever chaos is on my plate and Metrical figures it out. It fits perfectly into my routine. FAQ Common questions Is it truly free? Yes! Metrical is completely free with all core features included: AI meal analysis, photo recognition, macro tracking, insights, and more. No ads, no data selling. The optional Cloud plan ($29.99 one-time) adds cross-device sync, automatic backups, and enhanced AI. Do I need to create an account? Not for the free version. Metrical requires zero sign-up — you open the app and start tracking immediately. If you upgrade to Cloud, you sign in with just your email (magic link, no password needed). Where is my data stored? On the free plan, all your data stays 100% on your device. Nothing is sent to our servers. With Cloud, your data is encrypted and synced securely, but a local copy always remains on your device as an offline backup. How accurate is the AI? Works best with common foods and workouts. Include details like '100g Greek yogurt' or 'grilled chicken breast with rice' for better estimates. Cloud users get access to our enhanced AI model for even better accuracy. How is this different from MyFitnessPal? Metrical uses AI to estimate calories instantly from photos or text descriptions, no searching through databases. It's designed to be 10x faster, completely private, and has a generous free tier with no ads. What does Cloud include? Cloud is a one-time $29.99 payment that gives you lifetime access to: cross-device sync (use Metrical on your phone, tablet, and computer), automatic cloud backup, enhanced AI analysis with a more powerful model, and advanced long-term insights and trends. Is Cloud a subscription? No! Cloud is a one-time payment of $29.99. You pay once and get lifetime access. No recurring charges, no surprise fees. Does it work offline? Yes! Both Free and Cloud work fully offline. Your food logs, history, and stats are stored locally on your device. Cloud users get automatic sync when back online. Can I track macros (protein, carbs, fat)? Absolutely. The AI automatically estimates macronutrients for every meal. You can also set custom macro goals and track your daily progress against personalized targets. This works on both Free and Cloud. Is it available on iOS and Android? Metrical is a progressive web app (PWA) that works on any device with a browser. On iOS, you can add it to your home screen from Safari for a native app-like experience. No app store download needed! Thank you for using AiPlix. What began as an AI browser for one person is now WebRun, an enterprise browsing agent that runs a company's recurring operations. WebRun deploys AI agents that carry out the repetitive work your team does today, inside the web tools you already use: invoice reconciliation, lead enrichment, ticket triage, work-order intake and new-hire provisioning. Each one runs on a schedule and reports back when it is finished. There is nothing to integrate. WebRun operates software the way a person does, by reading the screen, so it works with applications that expose no API, including systems built in-house. A process is set up by describing it in plain language or by recording it once. Automation Policies govern what each agent is permitted to do. Every proposed action is checked against your policy before it reaches the browser and is either blocked or held for approval, and the agent cannot override it. Presets cover healthcare, finance, research-only and strict lockdown. Every session is recorded for review. The AiPlix browser remains available and will continue to work. We are no longer releasing updates to it, and our development now goes entirely into WebRun. Open WebRun WebRun, Inc. Formerly AiPlix. Privacy   Terms

GPTBox - ChatGPT and DeepSeek Integrated in Windows Taskbar GPTBox ChatGPT and Auto-Type in Any Windows Application Inline Let ChatGPT do the Typing Bring ChatGPT directly into your text fields, anywhere on your Windows PC. Transform your workflow by letting AI type your emails, generate code snippets, draft documents, or compose messages. Perfect for developers, writers, and busy professionals who want to save time and enhance creativity. Works in any text fields. Global ChatGPT at your Fingertips Access the power of ChatGPT from anywhere on your Windows PC with a simple keyboard shortcut. A convenient dialog instantly appears when you need AI assistance, letting you quickly get answers, generate content, or solve problems without interrupting your workflow. What Users Are Saying Discover how GPTBox is transforming productivity for Windows users worldwide. "Game-changer for Windows users" Having ChatGPT directly in my taskbar has completely transformed how I work. I use it dozens of times daily for emails, code assistance, and creative writing. David M., Software Developer "The Windows AI tool I've been waiting for" Finally, a proper ChatGPT integration for Windows! No more switching between browser tabs - GPTBox brings AI exactly where I need it. Sarah K., Content Marketer "Productivity on Windows, supercharged" I've tried several AI assistants, but GPTBox's integration with Windows is unmatched. The inline typing feature alone saves me hours each week. Michael T., Business Analyst Frequently Asked Questions If your question is not listed, let us know . Is GPTBox free for Windows users? GPTBox for Windows offers a free 7-day trial with full access to all features. After your trial period, you'll need to purchase a license to continue using our software. This ensures we can continue developing the best ChatGPT and DeepSeek integration for your Windows taskbar and provide excellent support for all Windows users. Is GPTBox free for Windows users? How do I get an OpenAI API key to use ChatGPT with GPTBox on Windows? To use ChatGPT with GPTBox on your Windows PC, you'll need an OpenAI API key. Start by creating an account at OpenAI's platform website (https://platform.openai.com). Once logged in, navigate to the API keys section and generate a new key. Copy this key and enter it in GPTBox's Windows settings panel. This enables ChatGPT's powerful AI capabilities directly in your Windows taskbar, giving you access to AI assistance in any application. How do I get an OpenAI API key to use ChatGPT with GPTBox on Windows? How do I set up Deepseek integration with GPTBox on Windows? To integrate Deepseek AI with GPTBox on your Windows system, you'll need a Deepseek API key. Visit https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys and create an account if you don't already have one. Generate your API key, then open GPTBox on your Windows PC and navigate to Settings. In the API section, select Deepseek as your provider and paste your key. Once saved, you can access Deepseek's powerful AI capabilities directly from your Windows taskbar, enabling advanced AI assistance in any Windows application. How do I set up Deepseek integration with GPTBox on Windows? Is using ChatGPT with GPTBox on Windows expensive? Using ChatGPT through GPTBox on your Windows PC is very cost-effective. API costs are typically around $0.001 per 1000 tokens (roughly 750 words). For most Windows users, this translates to just pennies per day of regular use. We recommend using GPT-4o for daily Windows operations as it offers the best balance of performance and cost. Is using ChatGPT with GPTBox on Windows expensive? Does GPTBox support DeepSeek and other AI models on Windows? Yes, GPTBox for Windows supports multiple AI models beyond ChatGPT. You can seamlessly use DeepSeek's powerful AI directly from your Windows taskbar by adding your DeepSeek API key in the GPTBox settings. All models work with our inline typing and global access features. Does GPTBox support DeepSeek and other AI models on Windows? How can I resolve technical issues with GPTBox on my Windows PC? If you're experiencing technical issues with GPTBox on your Windows computer, we're here to help. First, ensure your Windows is updated to the latest version and try restarting the application. For persistent problems with the Windows taskbar integration or AI typing features, please contact our dedicated Windows support team at support@gptbox.app. Include details about your Windows version, the specific issue you're facing, and any error messages to help us resolve your problem quickly. How can I resolve technical issues with GPTBox on my Windows PC? Can I request new features? Absolutely! We're constantly improving GPTBox to provide the best ChatGPT and DeepSeek experience on Windows. If you need functionality that isn't currently available, please email your feature request to support@gptbox.app. Our development team regularly evaluates user suggestions to enhance our Windows taskbar integration. Many of our most popular features, like multi-model support and customizable keyboard shortcuts, came directly from user feedback. Can I request new features? What Windows versions are compatible with GPTBox? GPTBox is fully compatible with Windows 10 and Windows 11 operating systems. Our ChatGPT integration works seamlessly with all recent Windows updates, providing optimal performance on modern Windows PCs. For the best experience with our taskbar integration and inline typing features, we recommend running on Windows 10 version 1903 or newer, or any version of Windows 11. This ensures all GPTBox features function correctly with your Windows interface. What Windows versions are compatible with GPTBox? How does GPTBox's ChatGPT integration compare to other Windows AI assistants? GPTBox stands out from other Windows AI tools by offering deep system integration directly into your Windows taskbar and any application. Unlike browser-based solutions, GPTBox brings ChatGPT and DeepSeek functionality natively to Windows, allowing you to use AI directly in Word, Outlook, browsers, coding environments, and any text field. Our Windows-specific optimizations provide faster response times, lower latency, and better context handling than generic AI tools, making GPTBox the premier ChatGPT solution designed specifically for Windows users. TranslateMyCall | Speak every language. Just dial. Skip to main content TranslateMy Call by ThunderPhone How it works Enterprise Privacy Dial now Translate 70+ languages by phone Speak every language. Just dial. One number. Two ways to be understood. In person On a call Merge us into the call — each side hears their own language. Call free from any phone (228) 888 8666 Dial now Save contact Carrier charges may apply No app required Free for a limited time No sign-up needed 9:41 T (228) 888 8666 00:04 mute keypad speaker add call video contacts Live translation EN ES You speak EN I'd like a table for two, please. They hear ES Quiero una mesa para dos. Both sides, live on the call 70+ languages, one number From Spanish to Swahili ES Spanish EN English ZH Chinese FR French AR Arabic PT Portuguese DE German RU Russian JA Japanese KO Korean HI Hindi VI Vietnamese +60 more 47 languages are officially supported with full quality; the rest of this list usually works with reduced quality. Languages not on this list may work too, but quality is not guaranteed. Try them out. Two ways to use it Bridge any conversation Whether they're across the world or across the table. On a phone call Face to face 1 Dial TranslateMyCall Call (228) 888 8666 from any phone, landline or mobile. 2 Merge your call Add the person you're calling. Tap your phone's merge calls button. 3 Talk normally We translate both sides out loud, live, in real time. Simple by design Just dial. That's the whole product. No downloads, no onboarding, no accounts. Any phone you can dial from is enough. NO SIGN-UP No account needed No sign-up, no name, no email. Just dial the number and talk. Straight talk on recording Calls may be recorded while the service is free, to help us improve translation quality. ThunderPhone Interpreting · for LSPs White-label our engine. Run it as your own. Visit ProSync+ Optimize your weekly schedule with intelligent task planning tailored to your goals. Visit Focus Forge Block distractions, track your time, and sharpen your focus – all in one browser extension. Visit Our Team at Zeriux Labs Passionate about helping people overcome procrastination through technology. Leading our mission to create accessible productivity tools that transform how individuals approach their goals and daily tasks. Adityan Srinivasan Founder & CEO Dedicated to designing user-centered solutions that make productivity intuitive and engaging. Focused on creating tools that turn procrastination into purposeful action for everyone. Amogh Varote Founder & COO Our Approach Phase 1 Research and Ideation Our journey begins with a thorough understanding of the problem at hand. We conduct in-depth research to uncover the core issues and pain points. This is followed by collaborative brainstorming sessions where our team generates innovative ideas. Each idea undergoes a feasibility analysis to ensure practicality and potential impact, laying a solid foundation for the development phase. Phase 2 Development and Implementation Once a viable solution is identified, we move on to prototype development. Initial prototypes are created to test and refine our ideas through iterative testing. This rigorous process helps identify and resolve any issues early on. The final solution is then implemented with a focus on scalability and user-friendliness, ensuring it meets the highest standards of quality and effectiveness. Phase 3 Evaluation and Enhancement Our commitment to excellence doesn’t end with deployment. We continuously monitor the performance and impact of our solutions, gathering feedback from users and stakeholders to pinpoint areas for improvement. This feedback is crucial for our continuous improvement process, enabling us to regularly update and enhance our solutions to adapt to evolving needs and technologies. evidence.text: mindlib â AI Mind Mapping for Personal Knowledge Management mindlib About Features Use Cases Pricing Login AI Mind Mapping made for mobile mindlib is a mobile-friendly Personal Knowledge Management tool that organizes your insights and ideas in a Mind Map network. The integrated AI provides personalized answers and suggests new content. Learn more Web App Web App a second brain Having a good idea or finally coming to a precious conclusion can bring up the question: How do I not forget this? mindlib is the answer you are looking for. Save your knowledge From spontaneous ideas to elaborated conclusions - everything can be persisted. mindlib offers various tools to simplify and accelerate information capturing. Build a mind library Create Mind Maps and connect them in parent-child relations. This results in a hierarchical network where all your information is put into relation at a central place. Find everything in seconds Either find terms with mindlib's integrated text-search or navigate through the network - or combine both: The power of relations lets you find anything, even if you can only recall an information's context. "To know is to know where it is written" - Albert Einstein designed for usability Managing a Knowledge Base on a mobile phone is an ambitious task, where many other apps fail. mindlib's key features focus on ease of input, retrieval and connectivity. Easy input via share Insert information directly into mindlib by using it as a share target. Title, description, URL and image of another apps source will be prefilled in your form. New, Browse, Web-Search: all in one Use a powerful all-in-one bar to find existing information, get suggestions from the Google Knowledge Graph or create completely new information with a single input. This prevents duplications and seamlessly extends your personal network by Google's Knowledge Graph, a massive database for entities. Work from anywhere and stay synced mindlib can be used on multiple devices simultaneously due to real-time synchronization. AI Mind Mapping: connect to your personalized Artificial Intelligence superpowered by AI Engage in dynamic conversations with an Artificial Intelligence to explore, refine, and expand your personal knowledge. AI-generated insights seamlessly integrate into your structured Mind Maps, enabling continuous learning and self-improvement. Intelligent knowledge retrieval The AI-Chat in mindlib leverages advanced algorithms to search through your mind library, pinpointing the most relevant information for your questions. By connecting the dots across your stored entries, the Artificial Intelligence ensures that responses are grounded in your curated knowledge, making them precise and context-aware. Knowledge-based answers When relevant information is found in your personal Knowledge Base, the Artificial Intelligence integrates it directly into its response. The sources used in the answer are displayed, allowing you to verify and explore the referenced information. This ensures transparency and helps maintain accuracy in your AI-assisted learning process. Expanding knowledge with Artificial Intelligence If no matching information is found, the Artificial Intelligence generates a general response based on its extensive dataset. However, you can refine this response, ask follow-up questions, or transform the generated insights into structured knowledge within your personal Mind Map. This allows for continuous learning, adaptation, and knowledge refinement. Create Mind Maps from AI responses With just one click, transform AI-generated responses into structured Mind Maps. These Mind Maps are suggested layouts that you can review before integrating them into your Knowledge Base, capturing valuable insights seamlessly. Natural Mind Mapping through conversation Creating a Mind Map requires both gathering relevant information and structuring it meaningfully. Instead of manual research, simply chat with the AI: it finds the key insights for you. The AI then organizes the content into a structured Mind Map, letting you focus on ideas rather than formatting. Save insights, grow your knowledge Important information and insights gained from conversations with the Artificial Intelligence can now be preserved and connected to other information within your Knowledge Base. Through continuous integration, your personal knowledge expands, which in turn strengthens the foundation of your personalized AI. Store your thoughts - a backup of your mind manageable, shareable Build and explore a giant library with ease, get it completed with automatic suggestions and share your knowledge with friends! Navigable graph editor Connect small Mind Maps to a Knowledge Base with an intuitive graph editor and compact forms. Find information by navigating over related topics. Information cards Information is presented in a card style with a carousel function. An overview section organizes a short representation of your cards in lists. Breadcrumbs uniquely identify similar topics. Derived Wikidata-suggestions Complete missing aspects on your topics with hierarchically derived suggestions from Wikidata. Rate and compare system Evaluate options by collecting arguments and rating them positive or negative. This gives you a basis to take action and enables you to reiterate the decision making process anytime. Share export with Deep Linking Send your information to other apps via share. Every shared information gets associated with a private link. With deep linking supported, these links will be opened directly in mindlib. OPML export and import mindlib supports the OPML-format as exchange format for Mind Mapping-apps. Exchange data with other apps or use an export as a local backup of your mind library. Reach 4000 entities in three clicks - with only 8 nodes per Mind Map lightweight and efficient Personal Knowledge Management could be the missing piece that puts together your workflows and data. See how mindlib's lightweight design enables powerful use cases! Central Organizational Layer Your data often resides in specialized, distributed apps which give you the best experience for editing, storage and presentation at specific needs. With mindlib you can connect and organize information from various sources in one lightweight, organizational layer. Learn more Note Taking Information and ideas worth noting down can arise at any place and situation. Therefore it is crucial to have a tool that is working mobile. Also, you want to be able to dump your notes as quickly as possible so you donât lose the context of your current activity, but still be able to organize it later. mindlib masters these requirements. Learn more Research Research is often about evaluating different hypotheses by gathering arguments and rating them in a pro/contra-way. mindlib's rating system is built exactly for this requirement and makes it easy to create a comprehensible overview of theories. With semantically derived suggestions from Wikidata your research can be inspired or completed on the fly, so that you always paint the whole picture. Which messengers does the client go to? WhatsApp, Telegram and iMessage, all from a single phone number. The client picks their preferred channel on the final screen. Do I need to code the branching? UpReady reveals how you're really doing by analyzing your health metrics with cutting-edge AI. Download Now Your health data stays private. Always. Previous screenshot Next screenshot Go to screenshot 1 Go to screenshot 2 Go to screenshot 3 Go to screenshot 4 Go to screenshot 5 Go to screenshot 6 Why I Created UpReady As someone who exercises regularly, practices karate, and occasionally burns the midnight oil coding, I needed clarity. I wanted to understand not only how I was waking up but also how my wife was doing—so I could be more mindful if she was having a tough morning and adjust our routine based on our metrics. UpReady is the Oura Ring and Whoop alternative. It was designed to work seamlessly with the Apple Watch Ultra, Series 10, Series SE or higher. For martial arts enthusiasts, it works great with the Polar arm band synced with Apple Health. AI-Powered Readiness Score Get a daily snapshot of your body's preparedness by analyzing more than 10 critical health metrics. Load Indicator Track cardiovascular and muscular stress from workouts with our proprietary metric system. Sleep Insights Understand your sleep quality with detailed analysis of sleep stages and patterns. HRV Monitoring Track Heart Rate Variability, your body's key indicator of recovery and stress levels. Friends & Family Share readiness and load scores with loved ones to foster support and understanding. Privacy First Your health data is yours alone. UpReady will NEVER store your health data, and your friends can only see your readiness and load scores—nothing more. evidence.text: HelperHat - AI Live Chat HelperHat demo video Your browser does not support video playback. How to Install FAQs Pricing Try for Free Grow Your Business While AI Answers 90% of Customer Questions HelperHat is an AI assistant for your website that gives your customers instant answers anytime. It's like ChatGPT, but it's designed to turn your website visitors into paying customers. It responds quickly, reliably, and in a natural, human-like manner. Start Free Trial HelperHat key features Quick & Easy Setup Install HelperHat by copying and pasting a single line of code on your website. No technical expertise required. Learns from Your Website Automatically uses your website's content to provide accurate answers. No manual inputs required. Human-AI Collaboration Switch between AI and human support for complex inquiries, with chat translations when needed. Unlimited Team Access Add and collaborate with unlimited team members at no extra cost (or "per-seat" fees) to provide customer support. Unlimited Conversations Handle unlimited customer inquiries with unlimited messages as a live-agent of your business at no extra cost. Unlimited Device Access Manage your customer support with unlimited devices, from anywhere, via our Web, iOS, or Android apps. $20 / month All our prices are listed in USD Get 1 month free on sign up 1,000 AI messages per month Unlimited live-agent messages Unlimited team members Learn More Providing Great Customer Support Shouldn't Break the Bank Small businesses often struggle with the high costs and complexities of providing effective, round-the-clock customer support. Staffing a full-time support team is out of reach for most. Yet slow response times can leave customers frustrated and dissatisfied. We created HelperHat to help small businesses like ours and yours provide helpful customer support, even when we're busy with the real work. Get Started for Free Let AI Learn From Your Website to Handle Any Customer Questions HelperHat scans your website and learns from the content you already have. It uses this as knowledge to give accurate, human-like answers to customer inquiries. Just enter your website URL, and HelperHat will take care of the rest. You may also upload any files or documents to improve its knowledge base. HelperHat relearns your website's content frequently, so your customers always get up-to-date responses. Frequently Asked Questions Quick & Easy Setup With No Technical Skills Required Getting started with HelperHat is simple. You don't need to be a tech expert or write any code. Just copy and paste a single line of code into your website. It works for any website including WordPress, Shopify, Wix and Squarespace sites. You can customize the chat's appearance, content, and placement to match your website. In just a few minutes, you'll have a smart, helpful customer support assistant up and running. How to Install Place QR Codes at Your Location So Customers Can Get Instant Answers With HelperHat, you can place QR codes at your entrance, counter, or checkout areas. When customers scan the code, they can ask questions and get instant answers from your AI customer support assistant. It's perfect for times when staff are busy or unavailable. Whether a customer wants to check store hours, prices, product or service details, HelperHat makes sure they get the information they need right away. Try It for Free Let AI Filter Out Spam Messages So You Can Focus on Real Customers HelperHat helps you stay focused on real customers by automatically spotting and labeling spam messages. It uses smart AI to detect fake or unwanted chats, so you don't waste time sorting through them. Messages that look like spam are clearly marked, making it easy for you and your staff to ignore or delete them. This keeps your inbox clean and lets you respond faster to the people who truly need your help. Get Started for Free When AI Can't Answer a Question, Chat Directly With Customers When a customer asks something too complex for AI to handle, you or your staff can step in and take over the conversation at any time (optional). Customers get the help they need, and you stay in control of the customer support experience. Start Free Trial Add Your Staff at No Extra Cost to Help Provide Great Customer Support You can add your staff to HelperHat at no extra cost. Each staff member can respond to customer chats, step in when needed, and help manage conversations. Whether you have one person or a few helping with customer support, everyone can log in from their own devices. There are no extra fees for adding people, so you can deliver great customer service without worrying about rising costs as your business grows. Affordable Pricing Plan Manage Your Customer Conversations With Our Web, iOS, or Android Apps HelperHat makes it easy to stay on top of customer chats wherever you are. Use the web app at your desk or the iOS and Android apps when you're on the go. You can view, reply to, and manage all conversations from any device. Your staff can log in too, so everyone can help out when needed. Whether you're at your shop, at home, or out running errands, you'll always have access to your customer messages. Web Track How Your AI Customer Support Is Doing With Helpful Analytics HelperHat gives you clear insights into your automated customer support. See how many questions were answered, how often you or your staff stepped in, and how satisfied customers are. HelperHat shows what's working and what needs improvement, so you can keep providing excellent service. Get Started for Free HelperHat vs. Competitors Discover how HelperHat outperforms other solutions in cost, efficiency, and ease of use. Kèo bóng đá live Kèo bóng đá trực tuyến (live) thay đổi liên tục khi trận đấu diễn ra. Tỷ lệ phụ thuộc vào tỷ số, thời gian còn lại cùng diễn biến trên sân. Ví dụ: Barcelona vs Sevilla có tài xỉu trước trận ở mức 2.75. Nếu Barcelona ghi 2 bàn sau 20 phút, kèo live có thể được điều chỉnh. Vì vậy, không thể dùng mốc 2.75 ban đầu cho kèo live. Các kèo phổ biến trên bảng tỷ lệ kèo nhà cái Cách đọc tỷ lệ kèo nhà cái cho người mới Bảng tỷ lệ nhà cái có thể khá nhiều thông tin, nhưng anh em chỉ cần đọc theo từng bước để tránh nhầm lẫn. Cách đơn giản nhất là xác định mốc kèo → tỷ lệ → điều kiện thắng hoặc thua. Xác định mốc kèo và cửa cược Ví dụ, một bảng kèo có các thông tin: Dortmund -0.75 | Leipzig +0.75 Tài Xỉu 3.0 1X2: 1.80 – 3.90 – 4.10 Đầu tiên, cần xác định Dortmund là cửa trên vì phải chấp Leipzig 0.75 bàn. Tiếp theo mới xem điều kiện của từng mốc kèo. Kết quả trận đấu sẽ quyết định cửa nào thắng, thua hoặc được hoàn tiền. Cách tính tiền theo tỷ lệ hiển thị Với tỷ lệ kèo nhà cái thập phân 1.80, có thể lấy 100.000 đồng để minh họa: 100.000 × 1.80 = 180.000 đồng Theo cách tính này, tổng số tiền hiển thị là 180.000 đồng, gồm 100.000 đồng vốn ban đầu cùng 80.000 đồng chênh lệch. Đây chỉ là ví dụ giúp người mới hiểu cách đọc tỷ lệ, không phải khuyến nghị đặt cược. Vì sao kèo luôn biến động? Thông tin về một trận đấu có thể thay đổi liên tục. Chỉ một diễn biến trên sân cũng có thể khiến các mức tỷ lệ được điều chỉnh. Ví dụ: Phút 10: Tỷ số 0-0. Phút 28: Đội khách nhận thẻ đỏ. Phút 43: Đội chủ nhà ghi bàn. Phút 70: Đội khách gỡ hòa. Mỗi thời điểm tạo ra một cục diện khác nhau. Vì vậy, tỷ lệ trước trận thường không giống với tỷ lệ khi trận đấu đang diễn ra. Bảng kèo nhà cái rõ ràng, dễ theo dõi Cách đọc tỷ lệ kèo bóng đá trực tuyến chuẩn nhất Khi cần theo dõi nhiều trận, anh em nên chia theo từng nhóm để dễ tìm thông tin. Các mục phổ biến gồm kèo nhà cái, kèo hôm nay, kèo trực tuyến và lịch đấu ngày mai. Theo dõi tỷ lệ kèo hôm nay Mục Hôm nay giúp lọc nhanh những trận diễn ra trong ngày. Khi xem một trận, anh em nên kiểm tra theo thứ tự: giờ thi đấu → giải đấu → cặp đấu → châu Á → Tài Xỉu → 1X2 → hiệp 1 → phạt góc. Cách xem này giúp nắm thông tin đầy đủ, tránh bỏ sót các thị trường kèo quan trọng. Tỷ lệ kèo trực tuyến Mục Trực tuyến dành cho trận đang diễn ra. Các thông tin chính của gồm: Tỷ số: Kết quả hiện tại. Thời gian: Trận đang ở phút bao nhiêu. Kèo live: Mốc cược đang được cập nhật. Tài xỉu: Tổng bàn theo diễn biến mới. Châu Á: Kèo chấp hiện tại. 1X2: Ba khả năng thắng, hòa, thua. Phạt góc: Số góc cùng mốc kèo. Ví dụ: Phút 65 tỷ số đang là 1-0 thì không thể đọc kèo giống thời điểm 0-0 trước trận. Thời gian còn lại, tỷ số hiện tại đã tạo ra một bối cảnh khác. Tỷ lệ kèo ngày mai Mục Ngày mai giúp xem trước các trận sắp diễn ra. Có thể thực hiện nhanh theo 5 bước: ① Chọn ngày → ② Chọn giải → ③ Tìm trận → ④ Xem kèo → ⑤ Cập nhật lại khi có đội hình. Cách này giúp chủ động theo dõi những trận đáng chú ý, nhất là khi tỷ lệ có thể thay đổi trước giờ bóng lăn. Tỷ lệ kèo trực tuyến theo từng trận Tỷ lệ kèo nhà cái hôm nay qua các giải đấu lớn Mỗi ngày có nhiều giải đấu diễn ra, nhưng một số sân chơi luôn thu hút lượng người theo dõi lớn. Bảng tỷ lệ kèo nhà cái cũng được cập nhật liên tục theo lịch đấu, giúp người xem dễ tìm trận mình quan tâm. World Cup 2026 World Cup 2026 diễn ra tại Canada, Mỹ cùng Mexico từ ngày 11/6 đến 19/7/2026. Giải đấu quy tụ những đội tuyển hàng đầu thế giới, tạo ra nhiều cặp đấu đáng chú ý. Tỷ lệ được cập nhật theo từng trận, gồm kèo châu Á, Tài Xỉu, 1X2 cùng nhiều thị trường khác. AFF Cup 2026 AFF Cup 2026 quy tụ các đội tuyển mạnh trong khu vực như Việt Nam, Thái Lan, Indonesia, Malaysia. Giải dự kiến diễn ra từ 24/7 đến 26/8/2026. Các trận đấu giữa những đối thủ quen thuộc thường thu hút lượng theo dõi lớn trong tỷ lệ cược hôm nay. Asian Cup 2027 Asian Cup 2027 dự kiến tổ chức tại Ả Rập Xê Út từ 7/1 đến 5/2/2027. Giải quy tụ nhiều đội tuyển mạnh như Nhật Bản, Hàn Quốc, Iran, Qatar, Úc, Saudi Arabia. Đây là sân chơi đáng chú ý với người hâm mộ bóng đá châu Á. Champions League, Europa League Champions League cùng Europa League là hai giải đấu cấp CLB được quan tâm hàng đầu châu Âu. Các đội bóng mạnh thường xuyên tạo ra những màn so tài hấp dẫn. Từ vòng bảng đến vòng knock-out, tỷ lệ kèo nhà cái thay đổi theo từng cặp đấu. Các giải VĐQG được quan tâm Bên cạnh các giải đấu lớn, nhiều giải VĐQG cũng có lịch thi đấu dày đặc mỗi tuần. Nổi bật gồm Ngoại hạng Anh, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, V.League, K League, J.League, MLS. Top giải đấu với tỷ lệ kèo nhà cái hấp dẫn Mẹo cá cược hiệu quả với kèo bóng đá Muốn hạn chế thua lỗ, anh em nên xây dựng cách chơi dựa trên dữ liệu thay vì quyết định vội vàng. Một vài nguyên tắc dưới đây sẽ giúp việc theo dõi kèo trở nên tỉnh táo, có kiểm soát hơn. Nghiên cứu kỹ trước khi đặt cược: Kiểm tra phong độ gần đây, đối đầu, đội hình, chấn thương, sân nhà – sân khách. Với những trận quan trọng, thời tiết cũng có thể ảnh hưởng đến thế trận. Quản lý vốn chặt chẽ: Không nên dồn toàn bộ tiền vào một tỷ lệ nhà cái . Có thể chia vốn thành nhiều phần, mỗi lần chỉ sử dụng khoảng 3-5% ngân sách dự kiến. Chọn thị trường dễ hiểu: Người mới nên tập trung vào những loại kèo quen thuộc như châu Á, Tài Xỉu hoặc 1X2. Hiểu rõ cách tính quan trọng hơn việc theo quá nhiều thị trường. Không chạy theo đám đông: Các lời rủ rê kiểu “kèo thơm”, “kèo chắc thắng” trên mạng thường thiếu căn cứ. Hãy tự kiểm tra thông tin trước khi đưa ra quyết định. Soi kèo từ nhiều nguồn uy tín: Đối chiếu thông tin về phong độ, lực lượng, lịch thi đấu cùng biến động kèo từ các nguồn đáng tin. Cách này giúp hạn chế phụ thuộc vào một nhận định duy nhất. Giải đáp nhanh về tỷ lệ kèo nhà cái hôm nay Tỷ lệ cá cược có nhiều dạng nên người mới dễ nhầm khi theo dõi. Dưới đây là những câu hỏi phổ biến giúp anh em hiểu nhanh cách đọc, cách tính từng loại kèo. Tỷ lệ kèo nhà cái hôm nay có biến động không? Có. Tỷ lệ có thể được điều chỉnh trước hoặc trong trận dựa trên đội hình, chấn thương, tỷ số, thẻ phạt cùng diễn biến thực tế trên sân. Giải đáp nhanh các vấn đề về tỷ lệ kèo Kèo 0.75 được tính ra sao? Tỷ lệ nhà cái 0.75 hay kèo 3/4 được tách thành 0.5 và 1. Nếu cửa trên thắng đúng 1 bàn, tiền cược được tính theo hai phần nên kết quả là thắng nửa. Tài Xỉu 2.5 hiểu thế nào? Mốc 2.5 bàn chia trận đấu thành hai cửa. Tổng bàn từ 0-2 là Xỉu, còn 3 bàn trở lên là Tài. Tài Xỉu 2.75 khác mốc 2.5 thế nào? Với tỷ lệ nhà cái mốc 2.75 được chia thành 2.5 và 3. Nếu trận có đúng 3 bàn, phần Tài 2.5 thắng, phần Tài 3 được hoàn tiền. Phân biệt kèo châu Á và kèo 1X2 ra sao? Kèo châu Á dựa trên mức chấp giữa hai đội để xác định thắng, thua hoặc hoàn tiền. Trong khi đó, 1X2 gồm ba lựa chọn riêng: chủ thắng, hòa, khách thắng. Tỷ lệ kèo có đảm bảo kết quả trận đấu không? Không. Tỷ lệ chỉ phản ánh mức định giá của thị trường tại từng thời điểm. Kết quả chung cuộc vẫn được quyết định bởi diễn biến thực tế trên sân. Kết luận Tỷ lệ kèo nhà cái giúp người xem nắm nhanh mức cược, diễn biến thị trường trước mỗi trận cầu. Theo dõi đúng thời điểm, đối chiếu nhiều mốc kèo sẽ hỗ trợ quá trình phân tích rõ ràng hơn. evidence.text: letsroll.ai - Your Professional Story, Beautifully Told It has been a wonderful year long journey of building letsroll . What started as a curiosity to see what could be done with LLMs, going beyond a simple wrapper, combined with our dissatisfaction with the current state of professional networking tools, turned into a valuable little product in weeks at the start of this year. Mid way through the year, Balach went deeper into coaching and Christian got busier with his main job. Before we realized it, our spare time wasn't so spare after all. We believe in following our passions but also doing a great job, and with new priorities, including families, we couldn't give enough time to growing letsroll. Kudos go out to Minna and Karo who joined us in spring and created the beautiful designs that you saw. After weeks of exploring our options, we realized that we could not do justice to this massive idea. We are open to selling the product as-is and/or the domain for someone else to build and grow it further. If you would like to take over, please reach out to balach@letsroll.ai . letsroll.ai shut down on November 30th 2025. Thank you for joining us on this journey! Elephouse hat bewusst eine einzige Eingabezeile und eine private Liste, die immer da ist. Keine Projekte, keine Boards, keine Ansichten, die man erst konfigurieren muss. Wer Todoist, Notion, Obsidian oder Apple Erinnerungen als zu komplex empfindet, ist hier richtig. Was ist der Unterschied zwischen privater Liste und geteilten Listen? Deine private Liste läuft dauerhaft unter deinem Namen und kann nicht geteilt, verlassen, gelöscht oder umbenannt werden. Geteilte Listen legst du zusätzlich an: flach und ohne Besitzer, alle Mitglieder gleichberechtigt. Eingeladen wird per exakter E-Mail-Adresse, die Einladung muss aktiv angenommen werden, und der einzige Ausweg ist „Verlassen“. Was zeigt die Ansicht „Heute“? „Heute“ sammelt alle fälligen und überfälligen Aufgaben über deine private Liste und alle geteilten Listen hinweg an einer Stelle. Dafür musst du nichts einstellen. Wo werden meine Daten gespeichert? Ist Elephouse DSGVO-konform? Elephouse wird in Deutschland entwickelt und betrieben. Die Server-Infrastruktur läuft bei Hetzner (ISO 27001 zertifiziert), die Verarbeitung erfolgt nach DSGVO. Details stehen auf der Seite Sicherheit & Compliance und in der Datenschutzerklärung . Kann ich meine Daten exportieren? Ja, jederzeit und vollständig. Elephouse exportiert alle Aufgaben, offene und erledigte, als todo.txt . Das ist ein offenes, reines Textformat: Es lässt sich in jedem Editor öffnen und in viele andere Apps importieren. Kein proprietäres Format, kein Lock-in. Auf welchen Geräten läuft Elephouse? Elephouse läuft im Browser, auf Computer, Tablet und Smartphone. Eine Installation ist nicht nötig. Welche Funktionen kommen noch? Aufgaben sind live. Ein Kalender, der Aufgaben und Termine automatisch zusammenbringt, ist in Arbeit. Geplant sind außerdem Gewohnheiten, Notizen & Tagebuch sowie Finanzen. Elephouse wird dabei nie komplexer als nötig. evidence.text:
Dream Advisor English Français Italiano Home Features About Contact Dream Meanings Blog Welcome to Dream Advisor. The first AI powered Dream Interpretation App! Dream Advisor is a personalized dream analysis tool that helps you interpret your dreams and tailor insights specifically for you. Do you want your personalized interpretation? Download the app now for FREE! Why use Dream Advisor? Personalized Dream Analysis AI tools interpret your shared dreams and tailor insights specifically for you. Articial Intelligence Interpretation Personalized Insights Dream Journaling Securely log and track your dream history and patterns over time Journal Dreams Timeline History Patterns Insights for Growth See how your dreams and self-reflections encourage personal development. Growth Reflection Development Insights Self-awareness About Dream Advisor We spend nearly 6 years of our lives dreaming, yet the cryptic symbols and narratives of our nightly visions often leave us wondering: what do my dreams truly mean? Dream Advisor is the revolutionary app that finally helps you understand the inner workings of your mind through the lens of your dreams. Using cutting-edge AI and a massive database of dream research and analysis, Dream Advisor can uncover the hidden meanings within your dreams in just moments. Simply journal your dreams each morning through our easy-to-use interface. Dream Advisor will then provide a personalized interpretation that sheds light on your psyche, emotions, goals, and experiences in a way like no other tool can. Dream Advisor offers a unique window into your inner self in today's world where mental well-being and personal growth are paramount.
