Your group just texts back. Sail gives organizers a powerful planning tool and lets everyone else participate through SMS, no app required. Start your first trip! Start here Create Trip Built for the one who actually plans the trip In every travel group, one person does all the work. Sail gives that organizer a structured itinerary builder, smart data ingestion, and delegation tools, while everyone else participates by SMS. No downloads, no signups, no friction for the 80% who just want to show up. Delegate tasks, create polls, and manage RSVPs in one place. Your group doesn't need another app Travelers vote, RSVP, and complete tasks through their default messaging app, with zero signup required. It works because it doesn't ask everyone to care equally. Everything the Organizer Needs Powerful tools for the planner. Zero friction for the group. Itinerary builder. Lay out activities, transit, and downtime in one structured schedule. Use the full editor to keep every segment clear from the first draft to the last change. 5:00 PM 6:00 PM 7:00 PM 8:00 PM 9:00 PM 10:00 PM 11:00 PM 12:00 AM Millennium Park 4:30 PM - 6:00 PM Dinner Options 6:30 PM - 8:00 PM Quartino Ristorante Alcanto Walk Downtown 8:00 PM - 9:00 PM Nightlife Stuff 9:00 PM - 1:00 AM Blast 9:00 PM Shopping 6:00 PM - 7:00 PM Task delegation. Assign booking confirmations, shared packing, and other to-dos to specific travelers. They get and complete tasks by SMS, and you see status in one place. Buy Sunscreen Assigned SMS polls. Run votes for restaurants, activities, or dates and send them to the group over SMS. Travelers reply from their messaging app and tallies update in your dashboard. Sail Pro Free covers essentials. Pro unlocks scale. Pro is built for larger groups, unlimited active trips, and automated planning workflows that save organizers hours each week. Compare Plans Sail Pro Unlimited trips, bigger groups. Run as many active trips as you need and host up to five hundred travelers on a single trip. Add people by phone and keep large rosters under control from the same workspace. Sail Pro Smart itinerary creation. Drop in a Google Doc, spreadsheet, or long group-chat paste. Sail parses the messy details into a clean, structured itinerary you can edit like any other trip. Sail Pro Proactive SMS reminders. Nudge travelers before key moments so departures, reservations, and meetups do not slip. Reminders go out over SMS without anyone installing an app. Sail for Tour Operators Scale your operations Purpose-built for travel companies and tour operators. Custom join links, white-label branding, larger group capacity, and analytics on traveler engagement across all your trips. Custom Join Links Travelers join via a branded URL for easy onboarding. White-Label Branding Your brand, your experience. White-label the trip interface so your clients see your company, not Sail. Engagement Analytics Track traveler engagement across trips so you can see who is responding, who is completing tasks, and where coordination is slipping. Common questions What is Sail? + Sail is group trip planning software built for the person organizing the trip. You build one shared itinerary, delegate tasks with real owners and deadlines, and collect RSVPs, poll answers, and reminders over SMS so your group does not need to install anything. Do the people I invite need to download an app? + No. Sail sends RSVPs, polls, and itinerary reminders by text message, so anyone you invite can respond from the messages app they already use. Only the organizer needs an account. Is Sail free? + Yes, Sail is free for personal group trips. Paid plans add unlimited trips, larger groups, smart itinerary creation, proactive SMS reminders, and itinerary broadcasts. What kinds of trips is Sail good for? + Anything where more than a few people need to end up in the same place at the same time — bachelor and bachelorette weekends, family reunions, ski trips, destination weddings, retreats, and recurring group departures run by tour operators. Can Sail be used by tour operators? + Yes. Sail for operators supports recurring departures with reusable trip templates, traveler tracking, and SMS broadcasts across trips. How is Sail different from a group chat and a spreadsheet? + A group chat loses information the moment it scrolls, and a spreadsheet is never open when someone needs it. Sail keeps one live itinerary, assigns tasks to named people with deadlines, and pushes the details by text on the day they matter. More on organizing group travel in the Sail blog , or compare plans on the pricing page . evidence.title: Launchpads — AI Product Studio
evidence.description: Female-founder-led AI product studio building AI-powered tools for organisations with a societal mission.
evidence.text:
Launchpads — AI Product Studio What I build About Knowledge Base Contact NL Let’s talk Offering About Knowledge Base Contact Nederlands The AI your team needed yesterday. Built this quarter. Launchpads AI is a female-founder-led product studio building agentic AI products for mission-driven organisations. Faster than an entire team, built AI-native. Already in production. Let's talk → Marta Strykowska · Founder, Launchpads AI Trusted by The Problem Your current systems slow you down. You run an organisation that needs AI to accelerate, but the systems your team works with were built for a different decade. Reports that take entire weeks to pull together. Data sitting in five different places. People downloading manually spreadsheets, copying and pasting things. You don't need another strategy deck telling you AI is coming. You need agentic systems that work alongside your people to make their work matter more. Today. → That's what gets built here. “ Marta kent geen "nee, dat kan niet". Zij denkt mee met de klant, probeert het onmogelijke mogelijk te maken en is onwijs professioneel. Wij zijn heel tevreden met de AI analyse tool die zij voor ons ontwikkeld heeft om ons werk efficiënter te maken. Wij kunnen haar 100% aanbevelen. Verena van Noort — Online Marketeer & Content Creator, Noordwijk Marketing What I build Examples of AI products you're looking for Launchpads AI product studio specializes in building AI-powered tools tailored to how your organisation actually works. Internal tools, decision-support systems, or agentic workflows that handle the routine work which your team shouldn't be doing. 01 AI-powered data analytics platform Turning scattered marketing data into better informed decisions. Read use case: Noordwijk Marketing → 02 Internal research and synthesis agents Hands-on in-company programmes that upskill your team in AI. Read use case: Adidas → 03 Build AI-driven commercial workflows Connecting marketing, CRM and AI to speed up marketing & sales operations. Read more → Built with About Marta Why I started Launchpads, an AI product studio Building systems that free humans to do the human work is now easier and faster than ever. Not every company operates at this speed yet. I build solo, using the most current foundation models (LLMs) available, which means I move at a pace a traditional team can't. My focus is working with mission-driven organisations whose people are losing time to outdated systems and bureaucratic friction. → Let's talk “ Marta really creates a space where it feels easy and safe to just start building. The energy and support from her and the group helped me turn a chaotic mix of ideas into clear, practical ones. Sophie Heijenberg — VC Investor, Graduate Ventures Knowledge Base Notes from the build. My own articles on AI prototyping, product validation, and what's actually changing in how software gets made. Written between builds, not instead of them. 09/06/2026 A building hackathon that delivered better solutions What I saw when finance experts started building their own tools during a two-day workshop, and why dismissing vibe coding might cost you the most interesting solutions on the horizon. Read → 05/05/2026 Why you're burning through Claude limits If you've ever opened Claude, or any other AI tool and seen a message saying you've reached your usage limit before lunch, this one is for you. Read → 03/04/2026 Build AI-Native Teams & Not Losing Your Best People AI is overwhelming. Meanwhile, your best people are moving faster on their own. We need environments where AI talent can shine. What is needed to make it happen? Read → → Continue on Substack Contact Prefer having better products , than prompts? Let's talk. I take on a small number of build engagements at a time. The best first conversations are with people who already know roughly what they want to change in their organisation. Send me what you're thinking. Within a week, I'll tell you whether I'm the right fit and how I'd approach it. Get started Start on Browser Your feed Live Jordan logged Morning mobility 88% commitment Â· this week You Private logged Evening journal Only you can see this Alex logged Read 20 min , short of the goal Still counts for consistency Sam posted a B+ weekly score card Strong week. Buddies can see it YourHabitBuddy now Morning mobility Reminder to log. Tap to open your habit picker. Log now Why it feels different Grades, nudges, and patterns, not panic Consistency and commitment are tracked separately. Show up often, hit goals when you can, and see both on your weekly grade. Break a bad habit Quit completely or cut back to a daily cap you set. Experience advanced tools, smooth workflows, and high utility mayak owner of deconec --> Got questions? Find quick answers to the most common questions about our platform What is Culture Counter? Culture Counter is an application designed to measure the cultural health of an organization. It is based on the framework outlined in the book "Love as a Business Strategy" and its subsequent book, "Love as a Change Strategy." The application provides a quantifiable way to assess culture and change readiness within a company. What is the LAAS Framework Culture Counter utilizes a framework based on the book 'Love As A Business Strategy' that is built on attributes that contribute to a high-performing team. These levels are: Behavior Attributes: Mindset, Attitude, and Communication. Culture Pillars: Inclusion, Empathy, Vulnerability, Trust, Empowerment, and Forgiveness. These scores collectively contribute to a High Performing Team score, which is a direct measurement of an organization's cultural health. How does Culture Counter collect data? The application collects data through surveys administered to employees. These surveys contain questions designed to assess individual actions, manager actions, and team actions related to each of the behavior attributes and culture pillars. Each question is typically rated on a scale, and the responses are used to generate scores for each attribute. The surveys are designed to be anonymous. Can I filter the results for specific departments or location? Yes, the application allows you to slice and dice the data based on demographics and formographic categories, such as department, location, working categories, and reporting managers. You can apply different filters within the application to see scores filtered based on these categories. Are the survey responses kept anonymous? Yes, the employee survey is completely anonymous. You will not know who rated what for any specific question or attribute. However, the data is aggregated to allow analysis by demographic categories. How frequently should we use Culture Counter? The initial survey conducted by an organization is referred to as the baseline survey. Any subsequent surveys are called pulse surveys (e.g., pulse one, pulse two). This suggests that Culture Counter is designed to be used periodically in a cycle of measuring culture, gaining insights, implementing improvements, and then re-measuring via pulse surveys to track the impact of those actions. Feel free to mail us for any enquiries : support@culturecounter.app Bringing Culture-as-a-Service to companies looking for resilience, belonging, and success. evidence.title: Paper Polyglot
evidence.description: Paper Polyglot is a cheap and efficient way to translate Adobe InDesign files in the browser, preserving all layouts and styles in the new language.
evidence.text: Paper Polyglot (function() { var link = document.createElement('link'); link.rel = 'stylesheet'; link.href = 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@400;700&display=swap'; link.media = 'print'; link.onload = function() { link.media = 'all'; }; document.head.appendChild(link); })(); window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || []; function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);} gtag('js', new Date()); gtag('config', "G-G5Z82V17S7"); gtag('config', "G-G5Z82V17S7"); Paper Polyglot Documentation Register Access Online Translation and Edition of InDesign Files Made Easy Translate your InDesign file outside of InDesign, re-download the translated file directly with styles ready. Register for free Easy translation You designed a document with many text frames and now you need to get those text frames translated/edited, but it's not easy to extract them or to send the files. With our InDesign file translator, you can do all of that, everything is online. Translators translate, editors edit, designers design. Automatic extraction of text frames Export your InDesign file in .idml format (File >> Export). The system will extract all text frames in seconds and make them ready to translate. Collaboration without signin required. Without login required, you can share the link to the translator. The translator can then start working on the text frame directly from the browser, with easy navigation and AI assisted translation. You can monitor the progress live. One click full translation When clicking "Translate all", you get automatic translations for all text frames. You can then accept them all in one click without further work, or you can select/edit the ones you want. Translated file ready to use When ready, re-download the file and open it in indesign: all styles are kept, only text has been replaced. Pricing plan Solo $12 /month One file at a time One file at a time Automatic translation 100+ Language support Free 25,000 characters translation Duo $22 /month Up to two files at a time Up to two files at a time Automatic translation 100+ Language support Free 50,000 characters translation Unlimited $35 /month Unlimited number of files Unlimited number of files Automatic translation 100+ Language support Free 75,000 characters translation FAQ What file format can I translate? This system is only for Adobe InDesign, and it requires uploading .idml files rather than .indd. What is .idml? .idml is a special format that can be generated directly in Adobe InDesign. It is called a markup language format and contains all text and style information from your original file. What is the AI assistant? A box with Google translation is provided so you can start with it, but you can edit everything afterward. Can I use this system to edit in the same language? Yes, you can use this system to also get comments and edits for your text frames without changing the language. Is this an official Adobe product? No, this product is not related to Adobe. DocAI is designed to feel like a calm health companion: it keeps context, spots possible patterns, explains what may matter, and turns the conversation into next steps while keeping the right boundary: education and organization, not emergency care or diagnosis. Context that carries forward Symptoms, reports, medications, supplements, and home-test readings stay connected so follow-up answers build on what you already shared. Action without false certainty Users get practical steps for today, plus clear reminders for urgent, worsening, or uncertain symptoms that need professional care. How it works How DocAI Works 1 Share symptoms or upload a report Describe what you are feeling, add a lab result, or save relevant health context so DocAI can connect the dots over time. 2 Get an organized health breakdown Review natural remedies, oils, teas, Ayurveda, lifestyle ideas, and medicine options in clear sections. 3 Know why it matters and what to do next DocAI explains what may matter, highlights red flags, and helps you choose practical next steps. 4 Return with your context intact Your conversations and health details stay organized so follow-up guidance starts with more context. Integrative Approach Natural and medical guidance, side by side. Health decisions rarely fit into one category. DocAI helps you compare natural remedies, Ayurvedic ideas, lifestyle changes, and conventional options in one organized answer so you can make better-informed choices. Describe a symptom, upload a report, or ask a health question, and DocAI gives you a structured response covering natural remedies, oils, teas, Ayurvedic ideas, and conventional medicine options in one place. Does DocAI include natural remedies, oils, and Ayurveda? + Yes. Is my health data safe with DocAI? + DocAI stores your chat history and saved health context to provide continuity. Uploaded files are processed to generate a response and are not retained afterward. Increase profitability and efficiency through data-driven decisions. 30 Day Free Trial - Schedule Your Demo Book A Demo Automating Operational tasks Reduce Time Spent By 80% Eliminate Manual Data Entry Hospitality Challenges Simplify Venue Challenges Running a venue comes with its challenges such as disconnected systems, time-consuming tasks, and limited insights. VenueLog addresses these issues, streamlining operations and boosting profitability. Disconnected Systems Using various systems such as POS, scheduling & rostering, and accounting creates inefficiencies and leads to inconsistent data, making it difficult to consolidate information and understand overall business performance. Integrated Systems VenueLog integrates your essential systems, simplifying data consolidation and reducing manual tasks. Automate your operational data flow and effortlessly gain comprehensive insights from a single platform. Time-Consuming Manual Reporting Manual data entry and reporting is tedious, prone to errors, and reduce the time time that could be spent improving your business and customer experiences. Automated Reporting and Insights Automate your reporting with VenueLog’s AI-powered tools. Save time, eliminate errors, and access accurate insights instantly, allowing you to focus on delivering exceptional service. Lack of Real-Time Data-Driven Insights Without real-time, easy accessible data, making informed and timely decisions becomes challenging, which can impact profitability and efficiency. Accessible Data for Confident Decisions VenueLog offers real-time performance insights, providing the data you need to make informed, profitable decisions instantly and efficiently. Difficulty in Forecasting and Planning Accurate forecasting for sales and staffing needs is complex without reliable data, leading to overstaffing or understaffing and impacting customer satisfaction. Accurate Forecasting with Advanced Analytics VenueLog’s analytics and forecasting tools provide precise sales and labour projections, allowing you to plan ahead and optimise your resources confidently. Benefits of VenueLog Instant Benefits For Your Venue Operations Experience instant cost savings and improvements with a venue management system built to simplify and automate your operations, empower your team, and increase profitability. Boost Profitability Increase your bottom line by making data-driven decisions, and saving significant cost with automated analytics and forecasting tools to identify opportunities for growth and efficiency. Real-Time Insights Make informed decisions with easily accessible live data providing real-time performance metrics, enabling you to respond quickly and effectively to changing conditions. Empower Your Team Provide every team member with the tools and insights they need to succeed. From owners to team members, everyone can benefit from VenueLogs solutions and contribute to the venue's success. Tell Me More! VenueLog Benefits Everyone Empowering Your Entire Team Discover how VenueLog provides tailored solutions for every role in your venue. From owners to team members, see how we help each team member succeed. Venue Owners Venue Managers Shift Supervisors Team Members Maximise Profitability with Complete Oversight Stay in control with real-time insights into your business. VenueLog consolidates sales, labor costs, inventory, and more into one intuitive dashboard, helping you make data-driven decisions to drive profitability and growth. Optimise Efficiency and Simplify Operations Streamline your daily tasks with VenueLog’s integrated systems. Automate reporting, manage projections, and access analytics to enhance efficiency enabling more time to focus on delivering great guest experiences. Effective Shift Management and Coordination Track venue performance data in real-time and streamline end-of-shift reporting. VenueLog provides access to key metrics like sales and labour costs, products sold, hourly breakdown, ensuring you can keep shifts running smoothly and make adjustments where required. Empowered with Knowledge Anywhere, Anytime Team members can access essential information like policies, procedures, menu details, recipes, allergens, training materials, and opening/closing guidelines using the AI Venue Assistant, from any device anytime. With questions answered in an instant, this leads to improved training, consistent service quality, and increased efficiency. Getting Started Simple Automated Operations in Three Simple Steps Getting started with VenueLog is easy. Follow these three simple steps to simplify your operations and boost profitability. Book It Schedule a demo with our team to explore VenueLog's features and how they can be tailored to your venue’s needs. Try It Enjoy a 30-day free trial and explore our platform’s real-time insights and automated reporting benefits firsthand. Buy It Choose a plan with affordable pricing that provides all the tools needed to simplify operations and maximise profitability. Simplify Your Operations and Boost Profitability Book Your Demo Today! Want to experience what VenueLog can do for you? Book a personalised demo and let us show you how to make smarter, informed decisions, save costs, and automate tasks. Smarter Decisions Saved Costs Automated Tasks Book A Demo Vario FAQ Frequently Asked Questions Do you have any Questions? We've got answers to help you get the most from VenueLog Getting Started Products & Features Pricing & Plans Support & Assistance Getting Started How do I book a demo with VenueLog? Booking a demo is easy! Simply click on the 'Book My Demo' button on our website, and pick one of the available slots to schedule a personalised demonstration at a time that suits you. Is there a free trial available after the demo? Yes! After your personalised demo, you'll receive access to a 30-day free trial of VenueLog. This allows you to explore all of our features and see firsthand how VenueLog can help your venue's operations. What systems can I integrate with VenueLog VenueLog seamlessly integrates with a wide range of systems, including POS systems, inventory management, staff scheduling, timesheets, accounting systems and more. If you're unsure about a specific system, feel free to reach us, and ask. We are always on the lookout for new integrations to add to our eco system. How long does it take to set up VenueLog With our user-friendly design and minimal setup process, you can have VenueLog up and running with your data and systems within a week. Our team will guide you through the onboarding and integration process to ensure a smooth and efficient setup for you and your team. Product & Features What are the key features of VenueLog? VenueLog offers a comprehensive suite of features, including seamless system integration, real-time insights, AI-powered tools like the Data Assistant and Venue Assistant, automated reporting, advanced analytics, forecasting with a customisable layout ensuring relevance to your venues size and requirement. These tools are designed to simplify operations, provide data to make better informed data driven decisions, boost profitability, and empower your entire team. How does the AI Tools work? Both our AI tools utilises advanced AI and natural language processing to provide you with insights specific to your business data and provided knowledge alongside the world of knowledge available from the AI, to evaluate new ideas, opportunities and other questions not connected with your data. You can ask questions in plain language, generate custom reports, save favourite queries, and share findings with your team. It makes complex data analysis, and venue knowledge accessible and easy for everyone on your team. Can VenueLog be customised to fit my venue's specific needs? Absolutely! VenueLog is designed to be flexible and customisable. You can choose which systems to integrate, select the metrics that matter most to you, and customise layouts to suit your venues requirements. Is VenueLog mobile-friendly? Yes, VenueLog is fully compatible with mobile devices. Our platform is designed to work seamlessly on smartphones and tablets, allowing you to manage your venue anytime, anywhere. You can even save the app directly to your home screen for quick access, removing the need for an App store and outdated versions. Pricing & Plans Can VenueLog provide custom developed solutions? Yes, VenueLog can provide custom developed solutions at a cost. The requested solution will be scoped to understand the requirements quoted before development commences. These cost are in addition to our pricing plans. Are there any setup fees or additional costs besides the subscription costs? There is an initial setup fee per venue which covers any data migration, integration connections and onboarding. Its worth noting that some integrations require a license fee, which is on top of the subscription pricing. If you have any questions about pricing please reach out. Our team is happy to assist. Can I change my plan later if my needs change? Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time to better suit your venue's evolving needs. Our goal is to provide flexibility as your business grows or changes. Do you offer discounts for multiple venue locations? Depending on the number of venues within your operation, you may be eligible for our enterprise pricing. Please contact our sales team to discuss your specific needs and learn more about our enterprise pricing. Support & Assistance What kind of customer support does VenueLog provide? VenueLog offers engaging customer support with a focus on your success, including live chat, email support, and access to our Help Center with user guides and FAQs. Our team is here to assist you every step of the way to ensure you have a smooth and successful experience. How can I get help if I encounter an issue? If you need assistance, you can reach out to our support team using our direct chat function on the platform, or send an email to support@venuelog.co. We're committed to helping you resolve any issues promptly. Do you offer training for new users? Yes, we provide training resources for new users, including onboarding sessions, tutorials, and user guides. Our team can schedule personalised training to help your team get up to speed quickly and effectively. Is there a community or forum where I can connect with other VenueLog users? We are building a vibrant community of VenueLog users where you can share experiences, ask questions, and learn from others in the hospitality industry. Stay tuned for updates on how to join our community. Hospitality Automation Home Products Pricing Contact us ©2024 VenueLog - All Rights Reserved. Privacy

Calorie Calculation Method This calculator uses the Metabolic Equivalent of Task (MET) method to estimate calories burned during yoga practice. The formula is: Calories = MET × Weight (kg) × Duration (hours) Different yoga styles have different MET values based on their intensity and physical demands. }); Yoga Session Calculator Overview The Yoga Session Calculator is a simple and practical online tool that helps users estimate how many calories they burn during yoga sessions. It uses scientifically recognized values known as Metabolic Equivalents (MET) to measure energy expenditure across different yoga styles and intensity levels. By entering basic details such as body weight , age, yoga style, and session duration, users can calculate their calorie burn rate and gain insights into their energy requirement during yoga practice. Formula Used: Calories Burned = MET × Weight (kg) × Duration ( hours ) This method is similar to other fitness estimators like a Calories Burned Calculator , BMR Calculator (Basal Metabolic Rate), or Maintenance Calorie Calculator , which help determine daily calorie intake , energy balance , and overall nutrition tracker goals. Purpose and Benefits The purpose of the Yoga Session Calculator is to promote awareness of how different yoga styles affect physical health and calorie use. It allows practitioners to plan sessions based on their calorie needs and fitness goals , making it an effective tool for both beginners and advanced yogis who want to track their progress. Personalized calorie goals: Understand your energy output for each yoga session. Weekly summaries: Estimate total calories burned over multiple sessions. Comparison chart: Compare energy use between yoga styles like Vinyasa, Power, or Yin Yoga. Health insights: Learn how regular yoga contributes to weight management and improved metabolism. How to Use the Yoga Session Calculator Using the Yoga Session Calculator is simple and takes just a few steps . The calculator is interactive and designed for a clear, straightforward experience. Enter your Body Weight in kilograms. Provide your Age and select your Gender . Choose your Yoga Style (e.g., Hatha, Vinyasa, Power, or Yin Yoga). Input the Session Duration in minutes. Select your Intensity Level (Light, Moderate, or Vigorous). Optionally, set your Weekly Practice Plan (sessions per week and duration in weeks). Click the Calculate button to view your results. The tool instantly provides your calories burned per session , along with metrics like calories per minute and the total calorie expenditure for your full yoga plan. You can also choose to display a detailed breakdown and a comparison table for better understanding. Understanding Your Results After calculation, you’ll receive an estimate of: Calories Burned per Session: Total calories used during your yoga practice. Calories per Minute: Average energy burn rate per minute of activity. Weekly Calories Burned: Estimate based on your planned number of sessions. Total Plan Calories: Total calories burned over the selected number of weeks. The MET value displayed reflects the energy cost of your chosen yoga style and intensity. This can help you adjust your training for specific goals—such as weight management , fitness improvement , or calorie deficit tracking . Practical Applications This calculator is especially useful for: Tracking calorie consumption and supporting a calorie deficit plan . Balancing yoga with other fitness routines, like using a Calorie Deficit Calculator or Meal Calorie Calculator . Estimating total energy burn to match daily calorie requirements and nutrition goals . Comparing yoga intensity with other workouts through activity calorie estimates . When combined with tools such as a BMI Calculator , Body Fat Calculator , or Lean Body Mass Calculator , this Yoga Calculator provides a broader understanding of your body composition and energy expenditure . It supports smarter fitness planning by showing how yoga contributes to your daily calorie needs and well-being . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) 1. How accurate is the Yoga Session Calculator? The calculator provides an estimated value based on MET data, which reflects average energy use during physical activities. Individual results may vary depending on effort, body composition, and metabolism. 2. Can I use this calculator for weight loss tracking? Yes. You can use the calories burned estimate from your yoga sessions to plan a calorie deficit . Combining it with a Calorie Deficit Calculator or Weight Loss Calculator helps you create a balanced approach to your fitness goals. 3. What does MET mean? MET stands for Metabolic Equivalent of Task . It measures how much energy an activity uses compared to resting. For example, a MET value of 4.0 means you’re burning four times more energy than you would at rest. 4. How often should I practice yoga to see results? Most practitioners benefit from 3–5 sessions per week, lasting 45–60 minutes each. Regular practice improves flexibility, strength, and balance while supporting your calorie maintenance level and overall wellness. 5. Can I compare different yoga styles? Yes. The calculator includes a comparison chart that shows how various styles differ in intensity and calorie burn. For instance, Power Yoga typically burns more calories than Yin Yoga due to its higher energy expenditure . Summary The Yoga Session Calculator is a valuable calories burned calculator that helps you monitor your fitness progress, understand your calorie burn rate , and align your nutrition and exercise plans . Whether your goal is to maintain weight , create a calorie deficit , or improve overall health, this simple tool can support a more informed and effective yoga practice. evidence.text:
Reflection 70B Online: Try Reflection Llama 70B LLM for free Reflection 70B Home Reflection 70B Pricing English Open menu Revolutionary AI Unleashed - Reflection 70B Reflection 70B is the next-gen open-source LLM. Powered by Llama 70B, it outsmarts GPT-4 with groundbreaking self-correction. Experience AI's future today! Try Reflection 70B Online 3 easy steps How to use Reflection 70B? Engage with our advanced AI model in just a few simple steps. Step 1 : Access the Chat Interface Navigate to our website and locate the chat interface. You'll see a clean, user-friendly design that's ready for your input. No sign-up is required – you can start chatting right away! Step 2 : Enter Your Query or Task Type your question, request, or task into the chat box. Be as specific or open-ended as you like. Reflection 70B can handle a wide range of inputs, from simple questions to complex problem-solving tasks. Step 3 : Engage in Conversation Reflection 70B will process your input and provide a response. Read the response and continue the conversation by asking follow-up questions, providing more information, or starting a new topic. Features Features of Reflection 70B Featuring state-of-the-art self-correction and pioneering training techniques, Reflection 70B delivers superior results compared to other LLMs. Innovative Training Technique Reflection 70B employs a unique 'Reflection-Tuning' methodology, enabling self-correction during generation. This significantly enhances the model's accuracy and reliability, setting a new standard in AI performance. Error Self-Correction A standout feature is the model's ability to identify and rectify its own reasoning errors in real-time. Using special tokens, it facilitates structured interaction and correction during the reasoning process, ensuring higher quality outputs. Seamless Compatibility Built upon Meta's Llama 3.1 70B Instruct, Reflection 70B maintains compatibility with existing tools and pipelines. This allows for easy integration into various workflows, enhancing productivity without disrupting established systems. Benchmark-Topping Performance Reflection 70B has demonstrated exceptional results across various benchmarks including MMLU, HumanEval, MATH, IFEval, and GSM8K. It surpasses GPT-4o and even the 405B version of Llama 3.1, setting new standards in AI capabilities. High-Precision Task Mastery Particularly adept at tasks requiring high precision, Reflection 70B breaks down reasoning into distinct steps. This approach significantly improves accuracy, making it an invaluable tool for complex problem-solving scenarios. Advanced Coding Capabilities Reflection 70B showcases impressive coding abilities, outperforming other open-source models like Llama-3.1 405B in coding assistance tasks. It's a powerful ally for developers and programmers seeking AI-powered coding support. FAQs Frequently Asked Questions Reflection 70B is here to assist you with a wide range of tasks through advanced AI-powered conversations. What is Reflection 70B? Reflection 70B is a state-of-the-art AI language model based on Llama 70B. It's designed to engage in human-like conversation, assist with various tasks, and provide information across a wide range of topics. What sets it apart is its innovative self-correction mechanism, allowing for more accurate and reliable responses. How do I start a conversation with Reflection 70B? To start a conversation, simply type your question or prompt in the chat box on our website and press enter. Reflection 70B will process your input and provide a response. You can continue the conversation by replying to its responses or asking new questions. What kind of tasks can Reflection 70B help me with? Reflection 70B can assist with a wide variety of tasks including but not limited to: answering questions, helping with research, providing explanations on complex topics, assisting with coding and debugging, creative writing, language translation, and problem-solving. Its capabilities span across multiple domains thanks to its extensive training. How accurate is Reflection 70B? Reflection 70B is highly accurate, often outperforming other leading models in various benchmarks. Its unique self-correction mechanism allows it to identify and rectify potential errors in real-time, leading to more reliable outputs. However, as with all AI models, it's important to verify critical information, especially for specialized or sensitive topics. Is my conversation with Reflection 70B private? We take user privacy seriously. Your conversations are encrypted and not stored long-term. However, anonymized data may be used to improve the model. For specific details about data handling and privacy, please refer to our privacy policy. Can Reflection 70B learn or remember information from our conversation? While Reflection 70B can maintain context within a single conversation, it doesn't learn or permanently store information from individual interactions. Each new conversation starts fresh, ensuring user privacy and preventing the model from being influenced by previous chats. What is your relationship with HyperWrite and OthersideAI? We have no collaboration, association, or affiliation with HyperWrite and OthersideAI. Reflection 70B is an open-source large language model based on the Llama 70B architecture, and we are dedicated to creating a transparent, reliable, and innovative AI platform. Can't find the answer you're looking for? Reach out to [email protected] Testimonials What Our Users Say Users are amazed by Reflection 70B! Check out what they have to say about using our revolutionary AI model. John Doe Software Engineer " Reflection 70B has been a game-changer for my coding projects. Its ability to self-correct and provide accurate solutions has significantly reduced debugging time. The seamless integration with existing tools ensures I can focus more on innovation rather than troubleshooting. " #AIRevolution Emily Chen Data Scientist " The precision of Reflection 70B in complex data analysis tasks is unparalleled. Its innovative training technique allows for more reliable results, which is crucial in my field. I've recommended it to all my colleagues for its exceptional performance in high-stakes projects. " #DataPrecision Michael Johnson AI Researcher " As someone who works with various AI models, I'm impressed by Reflection 70B's benchmark-topping performance. Its ability to outperform even GPT-4 in certain tasks is truly remarkable. It's become an indispensable tool in our research lab. " #BenchmarkBeater Sarah Thompson Product Manager " Reflection 70B has transformed our product development process. Its high-precision task mastery allows us to tackle complex problems efficiently. The time it saves us in problem-solving and decision-making is invaluable. " #ProductivityBoost David Lee Full-Stack Developer " The coding capabilities of Reflection 70B are simply outstanding. It not only helps in writing clean, efficient code but also in identifying and fixing potential issues. It's like having a brilliant coding partner always ready to assist. " #CodingWizard Lisa Wong UX Designer " Reflection 70B's ability to understand and generate human-like responses has been incredibly useful in creating user personas and scenarios. It's helped us design more intuitive and user-friendly interfaces by providing diverse perspectives. " #UXInnovation Try Reflection 70B Online! Simply use our search bar to enter your desired job title, skills, or location. You can filter results by experience level, employment type, and more. Our platform aggregates remote jobs from multiple sources to give you the most comprehensive listing. Is it free to apply for jobs? Yes! You can apply to up to 5 jobs per day completely free. For unlimited applications and additional features, we offer affordable subscription plans starting at €5/week. How can I get job alerts for new positions? Click the "Set alerts" button when viewing search results to receive daily email notifications about new job postings matching your preferences. You can customize alerts based on job title, skills, location, and more. What types of remote jobs are available? We list a wide variety of remote positions including full-time, part-time, contract, and freelance roles. Common categories include software development, design, marketing, customer service, writing, and more. Are the jobs worldwide or region-specific? We list both worldwide and region-specific remote jobs. Our AI-powered system analyzes each job description to identify location requirements and restrictions, making it easy to find positions available in your country. We extract and clearly display information about timezone requirements, work permit needs, and any geographic limitations specified by employers. What should I do if I need help with my job search? If you need help with your job search, please email mikhail@remoote.app. You can also check our resources section for tips on remote job searching, interview preparation, and working remotely effectively. How recent are the job listings? Our platform is updated multiple times daily with new job listings. We automatically remove filled positions and expired listings to ensure you're only seeing current opportunities. Where do the jobs come from? We aggregate listings directly from employer Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) including Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, SmartRecruiters, and others. This means every job is posted by a real employer on their own hiring platform, not scraped from other job boards. Our AI then analyzes each listing to extract requirements, skills, salary data, and location restrictions. What are the benefits of a paid subscription? Paid subscribers get unlimited job applications, priority email alerts for new positions, access to salary data, and AI-powered job insights. Premium members also get priority support. How can I verify if a remote job is legitimate? Every job on Remoote is sourced directly from employer hiring platforms like Greenhouse, Lever, and Workable - systems that only legitimate companies use. Our AI processes each listing to extract key details, and we automatically remove expired and filled positions within a week. We also recommend verifying the company's website before applying, and remember: real employers never ask for payment during hiring. Use For Free sliiidea is an idea management tool that keeps your ideas alive by prompting regular reflection and improvement. Ideas are immediately added to the evaluation flow. Find Out What You Really Like Regularly evaluate your ideas using our intuitive swipe functionality, similar to popular dating apps. This creates a strong basis for your long-term decision-making and ensures it's less influenced by your current mood. Simplicity and Focus Sliiidea is designed with a singular goal: collecting and evaluating ideas. This focused approach ensures you can concentrate on what matters most, without any distractions. Effortless Organization Organize your ideas in lists, apply filters, and track their status effortlessly. Keep everything structured and easy to manage. Never Lose a Thought again Effortlessly capture your ideas with a simple interface, ensuring you never lose a thought again. Ideas are immediately added to the evaluation flow. How it Works Get started in seconds 1 Capture Your Ideas Quickly capture your thoughts and (optionally) categorize them to keep things organized from the start. This continuous interaction helps your ideas grow and develop over time. 4 Organize Your Ideas Always keep track of your favorite ideas. When it's time to decide, you'll know which ideas have the best potential. Discard the ones you don't like and mark the great ones as "to implement." 1 Capture Your Ideas Quickly capture your thoughts and (optionally) categorize them to keep things organized from the start. evidence.description: Private, no-shame tools for porn/adult content habits, food cravings, gambling urges, alcohol cravings, and other loops. Built with licensed psychologists.

Neurture - Private tools for food cravings and adult-content urges {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Organization","name":"Neurture","url":"https://neurtureapp.com","logo":"https://neurtureapp.com/favicon.png","description":"Private, no-shame digital tools for cravings, urges, habit change, and recovery support.","sameAs":["https://www.linkedin.com/company/neurture","https://x.com/neurture","https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61560570178816","https://instagram.com/neurtureapp","https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-adaptive-mind/id1784456335","https://open.spotify.com/show/6MateEkcHSpFUTjavBr4Nc?si=907af9aee36c42ae"]} {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"MobileApplication","name":"Neurture: Craving Support","operatingSystem":"iOS, Android","applicationCategory":"HealthApplication","offers":{"@type":"Offer","price":"0","priceCurrency":"USD"},"description":"Private, no-shame tools for food cravings, binge eating patterns, pornography, and adult-content urges."} Home Resources For Organizations For Employers For Nonprofits For Universities For Treatment Centers For Professional Programs For Therapists & Coaches Team Partners Podcast Manage cravings and urges with science-backed tools Confront cravings, track your progress, and build lasting change with tools from ACT, CBT, and mindfulness-based relapse prevention. Download on the App Store GET IT ON Google Play 4.7/5 Home After your check-in What's Next Start with one useful step matched to what you just named. Breathwork Start here Do box breathing 2 min - Create space between the feeling and your next move. Coping Practice urge surfing 3-5 min - Ride the wave before acting Journal Journal about this 2-5 min - Name the thought that showed up Craving management plan Keep building a plan from the patterns you log over time. 4.7 ratings avg. rating Counselor's Choice Award Featured in MIND Apps App Store Review “ I see this app as being something I will use to reach many of my goals and manage my habits. ” ★★★★★ App Store Review “ The UX feels welcoming, calming and comfortable. Its a safe space to validate my feelings and get the help I need. Highly recommend to anyone struggling with addictive behaviors like me. ” ★★★★★ App Store Review “ Finally a digestible, simple app to help me better myself in healthy manageable ways. ” ★★★★★ Tools that work when urges hit Ride out cravings safely with urge surfing and in-the-moment coaching Calm your nervous system with guided breathing, grounding, and mindfulness Rewire unhelpful thought patterns by challenging permission-giving thoughts Learn what works: track urges, triggers, and outcomes across 75+ guided interventions and personalized plans Download on the App Store GET IT ON Google Play Free PDF Get The 5-Minute Urge Rescue Sheet A simple, evidence-based one-page guide for what to do when an urge hits. Built for real-life moments when you need a steadier next move, not a perfect one. Looking for other Neurture resources? Browse the resource library . What's inside A calmer, evidence-based way to respond to urges using grounding, thought reframing, and one next step. Built for many loops Useful for alcohol, smoking, vaping, scrolling, shopping, gambling, pornography, and similar repetitive behaviors. Low friction Enter your email and we'll send the PDF immediately. No long report and no quiz required. Email me the sheet We'll send the PDF to your inbox right away. You can also open it immediately after submitting. Website Email Also send me evidence-based emails, tools, and new resources from Neurture. Send me the PDF We'll always send the resource you requested. The checkbox above controls whether we also send broader marketing emails. Evidence-based Our evidence-based approach Neurture's tools are grounded in established clinical frameworks and reviewed by licensed clinicians. Below is how the 75+ guided interventions and personalized plans in the app map to the underlying methodologies. Clinical frameworks Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) : values clarification, willingness/acceptance, cognitive defusion, mindfulness Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) : cognitive restructuring, relapse prevention, behavioral substitution Mindfulness-Based Relapse Prevention (MBRP) : mindful awareness of triggers and cravings (e.g., urge surfing) Mindfulness, grounding, and somatic regulation : paced/diaphragmatic breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, NSDR/yoga nidra How this shows up in Neurture Urge Surfing and Sitting with Urges (ACT/MBRP) to ride cravings without acting Observing Thoughts and cognitive defusion meditations (ACT) Thought Trap Challenge , Straight Thinking , and Consequence Analysis (CBT) 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding , Breathwork (4-7-8, box, coherent), and Deep Relaxation/NSDR Values Reminder , goals, and urge/trigger/outcome tracking to reinforce change Frequently Asked Questions What behaviors can I work on with Neurture? + Neurture can help with porn or adult content habits, food cravings or binge eating patterns, gambling or betting urges, alcohol cravings or drinking habits, and many other repetitive behaviors that feel hard to interrupt. Is Neurture just for addicts? + No. Neurture is designed to support any individuals who are looking to address unwanted, compulsive, or addictive behaviors that they wish to change. It offers resources and tools like meditations, affirmations, journaling, check-ins, and coping plans aimed at fostering self-awareness and promoting healthier habits. Neurture is a subclinical app, meaning it is geared towards those whose daily functioning is not severely impacted by their behaviors. It serves as a supplementary aid that can fit into a broader care plan, offering support and resources that individuals can incorporate into their self-care routines. This can prove beneficial for anyone, ranging from those looking for extra support between therapy sessions, to individuals seeking to understand and modify their behaviors better. For persons facing clinical levels of addiction, where the behavior significantly interferes with their daily life and requires specialized intervention, it's crucial to seek help from healthcare professionals who can provide the comprehensive care needed. Neurture can be part of a broader, professionally guided approach but should not replace the specialized treatment that clinical addictions demand. While Neurture is beneficial for anyone interested in working on their behavioral patterns, it is not designed as a standalone solution for severe addictions. Consult with a healthcare provider to determine the best course of action for any clinical conditions. Who is Neurture intended for, and what reading level do you write for? + Intended users: Neurture is designed for adults and older teens who want to reduce or change unwanted habits and behaviors, including porn or adult content habits, food cravings, gambling, alcohol, and other repetitive patterns. It is not a substitute for professional care or emergency services. Reading level: We aim to write content at a general audience reading level (roughly 8th–10th grade) using plain language, short paragraphs, and clear headings. We periodically review content to keep it accessible. Language: English only at this time. Does this replace therapy? + Neurture does not replace therapy. There are many cases when therapy administered by a professional is the most effective approach to helping someone address their challenges or concerns. Even when someone is seeing a therapist, outside education about mental health can provide a lot of value to both the patient and the provider. Using multiple modalities, such as traditional psychotherapy and mindfulness, often increases effectiveness of treatment in general. If you are seeing a therapist or mental health professional, always consult with them about any changes to your mental health care. There are times when therapy isn't the best fit for individuals. It can be too costly for many people, too scary to discuss real issues, or simply not conducive to someone's schedule. And even more frequently, people have challenges in their lives that simply don't reach a clinical need, such as unwanted habits or behaviors that don't impair someone's ability to function or just everyday stress. In each of these cases, Neurture can serve as an effective piece of someone's treatment plan. Can Neurture help with my New Year's resolution? + Absolutely! With Neurture you can set goals and use tools that will help you actually achieve your New Years resolutions. With check-ins anytime and a library of resources to help you understand your habits and yourself, Neurture is a great tool for reaching your new year's goals. What should I do if I'm in crisis? + If you're experiencing a mental health crisis or having thoughts of suicide, please reach out for immediate help. In the US, call or text 988 for the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, available 24/7. You can also text HOME to 741741 for the Crisis Text Line. For comprehensive crisis support resources in your country, visit our mental health resources page. Neurture is designed to support you with daily challenges and unwanted habits, but it is not a substitute for emergency mental health services. Your safety is the top priority—please don't hesitate to reach out for professional help when you need it. Do you have investors or conflicts of interest? + Neurture has no outside funding or advertising. We earn revenue from user subscriptions. In some cases, if you install via a partner link, we may share a portion of revenue with that partner; partners do not access health data and have no editorial control over our content or recommendations. We have no conflicts of interest to disclose. See details on our Team page. How is my data protected? + Neurture keeps sensitive app content in encrypted storage on your device. This includes journal entries, check-ins, assessments, and plans. We do not provide partners with your journal entries, check-ins, or assessment responses. Some account, subscription, redemption, analytics, diagnostics, support, gift, and website data is processed by service providers as described in the privacy policy. You can use the in-app analytics toggle to limit usage analytics and enable a PIN or biometric lock in settings for an additional layer of protection. Recommended by Clinical Experts Leo DeBroeck, MS, LMHC, CMHS Sea Mar Community Health Center “ Empowers counselors to extend care beyond the therapy room while keeping clients engaged in evidence-based practice. ” Dr. Sarah Coe-Odess Mass General Hospital “ Neurture is a valuable, evidence-based resource with structured tools that empower users to break unhealthy patterns and pursue a more intentional, fulfilling life. ” OUR PARTNERS For Organizations Looking at Neurture for a team, program, or institution? Buyer-facing pages live here. The homepage stays consumer-first, but these pages explain fit, rollout, and privacy for organizations evaluating Neurture publicly. For Employers A private support layer that can sit beside existing benefits. For Professional Programs Between-check-in support for monitored and licensed professionals. For Treatment Centers A narrow admissions-recovery pilot for viable not-ready-now inquiries. For Universities Campus support that extends beyond business hours and waitlists. evidence.title: Camp - let's conquer screenshots
evidence.description: Organize your thoughts and inspirations with Camp on iOS and macOS. With AI, Camp automatically titles, tags, and extracts information you care about the most.
evidence.text:
Camp - let's conquer screenshots Camp. Workflow Features Reviews Download Camp is a personalized AI screen capturing tool capture once. remember forever. Capture Everything. Let Camp handle the rest. Capture Annotate Search Context. Saved. Camp automatically titles and tags your screenshots Intuitive Controls Keyboard optimized controls to supercharge your workflow Privacy built in All your data is kept locally. Period. Pin your favorites Every. Second. Counts Instant Search Fast, accurate, and easy Hot Key Support ⌘ ⌥ V Olina Chau This app saves me so much time it's incredible. Plus, Camp has been making me want to take more screenshots than ever. My library is filled with things I have been collecting from various corners of the Internet. Faraz Khan Been playing around with Camp for a bit now and I have to say, screen capturing tools have been needing a refresher for a long time.. and this team did it perfectly. Mike Wadhera Game-changer for managing screenshots and boosting productivity. It's super easy to organize and find the visual info you need, making it a breeze to capture inspiration and get results. Definitely a must-have tool in your arsenal! Seeing the Room Clearly Most teams do not fail because they lack intelligence. They fail because the room gives them bad information. People protect old plans, reward confident guesses, and confuse speed with progress. A better decision process starts by making the hidden pressures visible. Once people can name the tradeoffs, the conversation becomes less theatrical and much more useful. The important shift is not to remove emotion from judgment. That is impossible. The useful move is to notice which emotions are doing productive work and which ones are simply defending yesterday's choice. Teams that make this habit routine spend less energy proving who was right and more energy finding what is true. The Cost of Early Certainty Early certainty is comfortable because it reduces the number of things a team has to discuss. It also creates a trap. When a decision feels settled too soon, every new signal is treated as an inconvenience rather than evidence. Strong teams leave room for revision without turning every meeting into a debate from zero. They mark which assumptions are load bearing, which facts are still soft, and which tradeoffs deserve another look before the choice becomes expensive. A practical rule is to separate commitment from curiosity. You can commit to a direction while still collecting information that might change the route. That distinction keeps momentum alive without pretending the future has already been solved. Designing Better Defaults The smallest defaults often carry the largest influence. The order of options, the shape of a form, the first metric on a dashboard, and the person who speaks first in a meeting can quietly steer the outcome. None of these things look like strategy, but together they decide what a group notices and what it ignores. A thoughtful team treats these defaults as part of the decision system, not as background detail. Good leaders ask what behavior the system is encouraging before they blame people for following it. Overlays : Improves the readability of the text by changing the background colour of the output box. BoldCue : The first half of each word is made bold, providing clear visual cues that help your eyes quickly jump from one word to the next. We understand it can be challenging to define your goals, let alone set them; Simplify your goal-setting with our thoroughly curated habit library. We also recommend goals and habits to you based on your interest and preferences. Curated Challenges and Programs GetZing offers curated challenges and programs that help users develop new skills and habits. Whether you want to learn a new language, start a meditation practice, or improve your time management skills, GetZing curates and recommend programs that are tailored to your specific needs, interest, and goals. Reflection and Insights GetZing includes a journaling feature that encourages users to daily their thoughts, feelings, and progress. By reflecting on their habits and behaviors, users can gain valuable insights and make positive changes in their lives. Improved Productivity With the help of GetZing, our users can increase their productivity by developing new skills, habits, and workflows that help them work smarter and more efficiently. By integrating with other productivity tools such as calendars, to-do lists, and project management apps, GetZing streamlines your workflows and helps you stay Productive! Community and Accountability GetZing provides a sense of community and accountability by allowing users to invite friends as accountability partners. This social network around habit formation and productivity help users stay motivated and committed to achieving their goals. How GetZing App Works ? Create your goals Create your habits on GetZing or answer a few questions and we'll recommend habits/goals that will help you be productive. Get a Nudge Stay accountable and never forget your routine with GetZing's our smart reminders. Track your progress Track your progress over time, identify patterns and trends in your productivity and task completion, and use this data to help you make improvements GetZing + Your Calendar = More Productivity Get more productive with GetZing when you integrate it with your Calendar. Zing's AI intelligently blocks the best time on your calendar for your routines and tasks. Auto-Time Block Do you need help with finding the best time to achieve your goal? With our calendar integration, Zing looks at your schedule and recommends the best time for your habit, and can reschedule or reprioritize in a single click. Data Security Your data on GetZing stays encrypted at rest and in transit, and you can delete your account (and your data) at any time by just clicking a button. We'll never share or sell your data, cause that's just not cool. Bring your existing tool GetZing integrates seamlessly with all your calendars, so you don't have to worry about adopting a whole new calendar or task list to get the most out of GetZing. More integrations are coming soon! The GetZing Effect GetZing makes it easy to track your progress and achieve your goals. evidence.description: Get deep AI-powered analysis and instant summaries of any book. Understand key ideas, themes, and insights in minutes â powered by cutting-edge GPT technology.
evidence.text: Book-GPTs â AI-Powered Book Analysis & Summaries Book GPTs Benefits How it works Use cases FAQ Try for Free Benefits How it works Use cases FAQ Try for Free AI-Powered • Instant • No signup required Read smarter with AI Book Intelligence Unlock the core ideas of any book in minutes. Deep summaries, thematic analysis, key takeaways â all generated by advanced AI. â¦ Start Analyzing Books Free See how it works 500K+ Books analyzed 98% Accuracy score < 30s Analysis time 40+ Languages ð Thinking, Fast and Slow Daniel Kahneman • Psychology • 2011 Behavioral Economics Decision Making Cognitive Bias Psychology Kahneman introduces two cognitive systems: System 1 operates automatically and quickly; System 2 allocates attention to effortful mental activities. The book reveals how biases arise from the interplay between these systems, influencing judgments and decisions in business, investing, medicine, and everyday life... INSIGHT SCORE Read by curious minds from Stanford Harvard McKinsey Google Stripe Amazon Why Book-GPTs Your unfair reading advantage Stop drowning in reading lists. Get the intelligence of a book in the time it takes to drink a coffee. â¡ Instant Deep Summaries Get chapter-by-chapter breakdowns, core arguments, and the author's thesis â all in under 30 seconds. ð§ Thematic Analysis AI extracts recurring themes, philosophical underpinnings, and connects ideas across disciplines. ð¡ Actionable Takeaways Every analysis surfaces the 5 ideas most likely to change how you think â clearly, concisely. ð¬ Ask Any Question Chat with the book. Ask for examples, challenge claims, or explore a specific concept in depth. ð 40+ Languages Read the analysis in your preferred language, no matter where the original book was published. ð Compare Books Discover connections between authors, contrast opposing arguments, and build richer mental models. How it works Three steps to book mastery No setup, no reading list backlog, no friction. Just intelligence on demand. 1 Name your book Type the title, author, or topic you're curious about. Our AI knows millions of books across every genre and discipline. 2 Pick your depth Choose a quick 2-minute overview, a detailed chapter analysis, or a full thematic deep-dive. You're in control. 3 Learn & explore Read your analysis, ask follow-up questions, and save insights to your personal knowledge library. Try it now â it's free Use cases Built for every kind of reader Whether you're building a business or satisfying your curiosity, Book-GPTs adapts to your goals. ð Entrepreneurs & Founders Absorb the frameworks from the best business books â from "Zero to One" to "The Lean Startup" â without losing a week of execution time. ð Students & Academics Quickly grasp assigned readings, map out complex arguments for essays, and cross-reference sources in seconds. ð Investors & Analysts Extract mental models from finance and economics classics. Understand how the world's best investors think. âï¸ Writers & Creators Research narrative techniques, study how bestselling authors structure ideas, and find inspiration across genres. ð§ Lifelong Learners Finally tackle your reading list. Get the wisdom from hundreds of books a year without the overwhelm. ð¢ Teams & Managers Share book insights with your team. Build a common language and framework for strategy and leadership. Analysis features Every dimension of a book, decoded ðºï¸ Concept Mapping Visual breakdown of how ideas connect within a book, from premise to conclusion. âï¸ Quote Extraction The most powerful lines from each book, curated by AI and ready to share. âï¸ Critical Perspective Balanced analysis including critiques and counterarguments â not just praise. ð Related Books Discover what to read next based on themes, author influence, and reading level. ð Readability Score Understand complexity, time-to-read, and whether a book fits your current level. ð Atomic Habits James Clear • Self-Help Core Thesis Tiny changes â just 1% better every day â compound into remarkable results. Systems beat goals. Key Concept The 4-step habit loop: Cue â Craving â Response â Reward. Make habits obvious, attractive, easy, and satisfying. Top Takeaway Identity-based habits: focus on who you want to become, not what you want to achieve. Insight Score Actionability: exceptional FAQ Questions & answers Everything you need to know before diving in. How accurate are the book analyses? â¾ Our AI is trained on a vast corpus of literary criticism, academic papers, and reader reviews. Analyses are structured around the actual content of each book with a strong focus on accuracy. For popular titles, we achieve over 98% alignment with professional reviews. Does it replace reading the actual book? â¾ It depends on your goal. If you want to decide whether a book is worth reading, or need to quickly grasp its ideas for a meeting or presentation, Book-GPTs is perfect. Many users use it as a companion while reading to deepen their understanding â not as a replacement. What types of books are supported? â¾ Non-fiction (business, psychology, science, philosophy, history, self-help), fiction (novels, short stories, literary classics), and academic texts. We cover books across 40+ languages and support titles from any country. Is it really free to use? â¾ Yes. You can analyze books, get summaries, and ask follow-up questions for free. Premium features â such as full chapter-by-chapter analysis, book comparison, and team sharing â are available in the Pro plan. How is Book-GPTs different from other summary tools? â¾ Most tools give you a static summary. Book-GPTs is interactive â you can ask follow-up questions, explore specific themes, challenge the AI, and connect ideas across multiple books. It's a thinking partner, not just a text compressor. Can I use it for academic or professional research? â¾ Absolutely. Many researchers, analysts, and consultants use Book-GPTs to rapidly survey literature, extract specific data points, and build bibliographies. Always cross-reference with primary sources for citation purposes. Get started today Your next great idea is in a book. Find it in seconds. Join thousands of curious minds who already use AI to read smarter, learn faster, and think deeper. â¦ Start Analyzing Books â Free Book GPTs AI-powered book analysis and summaries. PromptSpeak is an innovative iOS and MacOS app that provides AI-enhanced chatrooms, offering users the ability to craft, refine, and enhance written communication across various formats with the help of specialized AI bots. How does PromptSpeak work? The app features pre-prompted chatrooms where users interact with AI bots designed for specific tasks like drafting social media posts, composing emails, or organizing notes. The AI suggests edits and improvements in real time to enhance your content. Who can benefit from using PromptSpeak? Anyone looking to improve their written communication can benefit from PromptSpeak — from students and professionals drafting emails to influencers creating social media content and individuals seeking to articulate their thoughts more clearly. Is PromptSpeak available in multiple languages? Yes, currently PromptSpeak supports both English and German, providing versatile assistance for a broader user base. What kind of images can PromptSpeak create? The image and video feature is currently under construction Can PromptSpeak help me with academic note-taking? Absolutely. Our 'Notes Taker' bot specializes in structuring spoken information into organized, book-like notes with clear chapters and key information highlights. What makes PromptSpeak different from other writing tools? PromptSpeak is unique in its use of specialized AI bots that not only assist with initial writing tasks but also provide iterative enhancements and suggestions, improving your content as you go. Is my data secure when using PromptSpeak? Yes, data security is a priority for us. We use encryption and robust security measures to ensure your information is protected and private. How can I get started with PromptSpeak? Simply download the app from the iOS App Store or MacOS App Store, choose your AI bot, and begin creating content with AI-powered assistance immediately. © PromptSpeak.AI - Made in 🇩🇪 by neurocode I/O

.lp {
 --ink: #0b0b14; --muted: #5f5f6b; --muted-2: #6c6c79; --tld: #9aa0ad;
 --canvas: #ffffff;
 --glass: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.62), rgba(255,255,255,.40));
 --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,.70);
 --glass-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35), 0 1px 1px rgba(13,15,40,.04), 0 34px 64px -26px rgba(46,54,120,.30), 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(70,80,190,.20);
 --field: rgba(255,255,255,.55); --field-border: rgba(13,15,40,.14); --field-border-hover: rgba(13,15,40,.24);
 --accent: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a84ff 0%, #5e5ce6 55%, #8e8bff 100%);
 --focus: #5e5ce6; --err: #c4282d;

 /* 8-pt spacing scale (4-pt base) */
 --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px; --space-5: 20px;

 --type-trim: 0.13em;

 position: relative; min-height: 100dvh; overflow-x: hidden;
 color: var(--ink); background: var(--canvas);
 font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Inter", system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
 -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {

 --ink: #f4f5fb; --muted: #a2a4b4; --muted-2: #9496ab; --tld: #74778f;

.lp-card {
 position: relative; width: min(444px,100%);
 border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); background: var(--glass);
 border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow);
 padding: clamp(18px,2.6vw,24px); text-align: left; overflow: hidden;
}
.lp-card::before {
 content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; border-radius: inherit;
 background: radial-gradient(42% 58% at 34% 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.55), transparent 60%);
 opacity: .8; mix-blend-mode: screen;
}
.lp-card > * { position: relative; }

 box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5); transition: border-color .15s ease;
}
.lp-opt input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.lp-dot { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--field-border); flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.lp-dot::after { content: ""; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); transform: scale(0); transition: transform .16s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
.lp-opt:has(input:checked) { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 60%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6); border-color: transparent; }
.lp-opt input:checked ~ .lp-dot { border-color: transparent; }
.lp-opt input:checked ~ .lp-dot::after { transform: scale(1); }
.lp-opt .lp-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; }
.lp-opt .lp-label { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.lp-opt .lp-hint { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.lp-opt .lp-price { margin-left: auto; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; }

.lp-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

.lp-field::placeholder { color: transparent; }
.lp-field:hover { border-color: var(--field-border-hover); }

.lp-field:focus ~ .lp-lbl,
.lp-field:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ .lp-lbl {

.lp-field:focus {

 box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 15%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5);
}
.lp-field:focus-visible { outline: none; }

/* amount: leading $, trailing USD; hide the native number spinner */
.lp-float.lp-amount .lp-field { padding: 15px 56px 15px 16px; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.02em; transition: border-color .18s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, padding-left .18s ease; -moz-appearance: textfield; appearance: textfield; }
.lp-float.lp-amount .lp-field::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
.lp-float.lp-amount .lp-field::-webkit-inner-spin-button { -webkit-appearance: none; margin: 0; }
.lp-float.lp-amount .lp-cur { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .18s ease; }
.lp-float.lp-amount .lp-field:focus ~ .lp-cur, .lp-float.lp-amount .lp-field:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ .lp-cur { opacity: 1; }

.lp-float.lp-amount .lp-field:focus, .lp-float.lp-amount .lp-field:not(:placeholder-shown) { padding-left: 30px; }
.lp-float.lp-amount .lp-field:focus ~ .lp-lbl, .lp-float.lp-amount .lp-field:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ .lp-lbl { transform: translateY(-50%) scale(.62); top: 0; }

.lp-float.lp-message .lp-field { resize: none; line-height: 1.45; font-size: 14.5px; padding: 16px 16px 12px; }

.lp-float.lp-message .lp-field:focus ~ .lp-lbl, .lp-float.lp-message .lp-field:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ .lp-lbl { transform: scale(.78); top: 0; }

.lp-hp { position: absolute; left: -9999px; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; }

/* ── CTA: flat black. No blooms, blur, border, or shadow. ── */
.lp-cta {
 margin-top: var(--space-3); width: 100%; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
 padding: 16px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer;
 color: #fff; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.01em;
 background: #111317;
 transition: background-color .15s ease, opacity .15s ease;
}
.lp-cta svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.lp-cta:hover { background: #1c1f27; }
.lp-cta:active { background: #0c0d10; }
.lp-cta:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }

.lp-scroll-hint { position: absolute; bottom: clamp(14px,3vh,26px); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); color: var(--muted-2); opacity: .7; animation: lp-bob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }

.lp-faq { max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: clamp(36px,8vh,84px) clamp(18px,3.2vw,40px) clamp(40px,7vh,72px); }
.lp-faq h2 { margin: 0 0 clamp(18px,3.4vh,30px); text-align: center; font-size: clamp(1.5rem,3.4vw,2rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.025em; }

Not just technology but a companion - someone to listen to, chat with, remember the stories, and share a moment of warmth when needed. Many conversations with seniors, families, and caregivers shaped our AI Community Managers. Every voice helped us understand what truly matters: being seen, being heard, and not feeling alone.
