Ringo is ChatLingo's AI character — not a faceless chatbot, but a personality. She remembers your conversations. She notices when you improve. And she keeps it fun, whether you're stumbling through your first Japanese sentence or finally nailing that Korean grammar point you've been wrestling with. The more you talk with Ringo, the more she feels like yours. 🗣 Speaks Japanese, Korean, English & more 🧠 Remembers your progress across sessions 💬 Corrects gently — keeps the conversation going 🎌 Built for anime & K-pop learners Why it actually works Forget the drills. Here's what makes ChatLingo different. Ringo remembers you Every conversation picks up where you left off. Ringo tracks your weak spots, your progress, and your style — so nothing feels like starting over. Real conversations, not exercises No fill-in-the-blank. No vocabulary lists. Just back-and-forth chat in your target language — natural, contextual, and surprisingly fun. Gentle corrections, instantly Make a mistake? Ringo catches it right away and shows you the right way — without killing the vibe. You learn without even realizing you're learning. Made for your world Japanese for anime fans. Korean for K-drama lovers. English for gamers. ChatLingo is built around the culture that made you want to learn in the first place. The longer you stay, the better it gets Ringo adapts to your vocabulary, tone, and goals over time. The more you invest, the more irreplaceable she becomes. That's the whole point. Zero judgment, always Ringo never rolls her eyes. Mess up your pronunciation, forget a word, mix languages mid-sentence — it doesn't matter. This is your safe space to be imperfect. See Ringo in action A real conversation. A real correction. In under 10 minutes. From people who actually kept going "I've tried Duolingo like 10 times. I actually kept coming back to ChatLingo because... I just wanted to see what Ringo would say next lol" @sakura_jp Japanese learner "My Korean got so much better but honestly I just love chatting with Ringo. It doesn't feel like studying at all." Emma L. Korean learner & K-pop fan "I finally watched an anime episode without subtitles and understood like 80% of it. Three months with Ringo." Marcus T. Japanese learner Questions? (Ringo's got answers.) Who is Ringo? Ringo is ChatLingo's AI character — a language partner with personality. She remembers your conversations, adapts to your level, and makes learning feel less like studying and more like hanging out with someone who happens to be trilingual. Is this like Duolingo? Not really. Duolingo is great for vocabulary drills and streaks. ChatLingo is about having real conversations with a character who actually remembers you. If you've ever wanted an AI friend who helps you learn Japanese or Korean, this is closer to that. What languages does ChatLingo support? Japanese, Korean, English, Spanish, French, and Mandarin Chinese — with more coming. Each with native-level conversation and cultural context. Do I need to already know some Japanese or Korean? Nope. Ringo starts wherever you are — complete beginner to advanced. She adjusts automatically. Is ChatLingo free? Yes — ChatLingo will launch with a free plan for daily AI conversation practice. Premium will unlock unlimited sessions and advanced feedback. When will ChatLingo be available? ChatLingo is launching soon on iOS and Android. Stat gives you the data you always wished you had—to prove what’s working—and what’s not. See Stat in Action Used (and Loved) by Healthcare Organizations Across the Country Healthcare inefficiency is a problem Running Blind Costs Your Organization Every Day Your team already knows these problems. Here's what they're actually costing you. Wasted Staff Time Your MAs are looking for providers. Your providers are looking for MAs. Everyone is peeking through exam doors, checking hallways, and running back and forth—instead of seeing patients. It happens all day, every day, in every clinic. Across your team, that's hours of clinical time lost to a problem that shouldn't exist. 45 min Provider Time Wasted Daily As reported by providers pre-Stat. Lost Patient Capacity When your clinic starts the day behind, it never catches up. Slow room turnover, bottlenecked handoffs, and patients sitting in exam rooms with no one aware they're waiting—it all compounds. Every lost slot is a patient who needed to be seen and revenue your clinic didn't capture. 2 patients Lost Every Day Along with the billable revenue those patients represent. Lack Of Data Visibility You can't improve what you can't see. Most clinics don't measure cycle time, don't know where throughput breaks down, and have no baseline to evaluate staffing decisions or process changes. Operational improvement becomes guesswork, driven by anecdotes, hunches, or whoever speaks loudest in the meeting. 13.9 % Actual Avg. Room Utilization (Most operations leaders believe the average is near 40%.) Stat diagnoses and treats care Dysfunction See How Stat Works One platform replaces flag systems, PA announcements, and manual tracking. Watch the video below to see how: Real-Time Location Instantly Know Where Team Members and Patients Are Stat shows your team's real-time location on a single screen. No one updates a flag or answers a page. Staff find each other in seconds instead of minutes—and shared equipment like vital carts are visible too. Learn more about RTLS Easy patient flow Replace Flag Systems and Hallway convos with One-Touch Workflows Intake done? Tap "Ready for Provider." Need a lab draw? Tap the icon. Room status LEDs on every tablet communicate what's happening at a glance — no doors opened, no hallway hunting. Your team stops running and starts coordinating. Learn more about patient flow actionable insights Get Cycle Time and Utilization Data Without Manual Entry Stat captures every phase of every visit from check-in to check-out, with zero manual entry. You see where bottlenecks form, which providers need support, and how changes impact flow — in real time or in weekly reports. No spreadsheets. No stopwatches. Learn more about data & reports Safety & Duress Stat Gets Help Fast Because Every Second Matters in Emergencies Stat Tags are wearables that instantly broadcast a location-aware voice and text alert to every room and person in your organization with a simple press of a button. No hunting for help, and no fumbling with phones. Learn more about smart alerts Stat diagnoses and treats care Dysfunction Flag systems and stopwatches were never built for this. Stat replaces the outdated tools your team has outgrown and supercharges your operations with actionable data. Staff Location OLD WAY Flags & PA Announcments Flag systems only work when everyone remembers to update them—and most don't. PA announcements interrupt everyone. NEW WAY Automatic Real-Time Location Stat shows you where every provider and MA is on a single screen. Your team just works, and you always know where to find them. Flow & Cycle Time OLD WAY Stopwatches & Spreadsheets Manual time studies take weeks, and produce a snapshot that's outdated the day the report is finished. Most clinics don't measure cycle time at all. NEW WAY Automated Cycle Time Data Stat measures every phase of the patient visit automatically without badging in, entering data, or one-time studies nobody trusts. Operational Analytics OLD WAY Gut Feel and Anecdotes Without real data, operational decisions come down to gut instinct and secondhand reports. You know something is off—but can't prove it. NEW WAY Real-time Ops Dashboards Stat gives you live views of patient flow, and room utilization. You see bottlenecks form and which sites need support—with data, not feelings. Emergency & Safety Alerts OLD WAY Pagers, Buttons & Landlines In emergencies, staff often have to leave a patient in distress to find help or reach a wall-mounted phone. Precious minutes are wasted. NEW WAY 1-Touch, Location-Aware Alerts Stat Tags turn every staff member into a mobile emergency signal. With a single press, a "Code Blue" or duress alert is broadcast department-wide Built into every Stat deployment Other features that bring even more efficiency to your organization. Safety & Duress Alerts One-touch emergency alerts from any Stat Tag or tablet. Alerts are location-aware, so the entire clinic see where help is needed and what kind of emergency was called. evidence.description: Discover PopboxGPT, the powerful GPT Chrome extension that brings AI-powered assistance right in your browser. Enhance productivity and simplify tasks with this intuitive browser-based AI helper.
evidence.text: PopboxGPT: AI-Powered GPT Chrome Extension Providing Instant In-Browser Assistance Login Sign Up An AI Assistant Instantly Available On Any Webpage Beautifully designed and remarkably simple Launch the demo In-Browser AI Assistance at Your Fingertips With PopboxGPT's AI browser assistant, you can tackle complex tasks with ease and save valuable time. Our AI-powered browser extension offers a range of features, such as hotkey fast-access, long-term session history, free-floating window and full-screen mode. Simple and easy PopboxGPT is designed for simplicity and ease, offering a user-friendly interface and intuitive features, making AI assistance accessible and efficient for everyone. Embedded Modal Effortlessly access PopboxGPT's capabilities through its embedded modal, providing a non-intrusive, compact AI assistant that blends seamlessly with your browsing experience. Available on all websites Experience seamless AI assistance across the web with PopboxGPT, compatible with all websites, ensuring you have access to the powerful AI helper wherever you browse. Instant Hotkey Access Quickly access PopboxGPT with hotkeys: Press Alt+J to open the AI assistant and have the answers to your questions immediately. Fullscreen Mode Enjoy an immersive experience with PopboxGPT's full-screen mode: Press Alt+K to expand the AI assistant, providing an uninterrupted view for seamless interactions. Long-term session history Never lose track of your work with PopboxGPT's long-term session history, preserving your interactions and progress across multiple sessions for easy reference and continuity. Get the Chrome Extension Discover a new level of convenience and productivity with the PopBoxGPT Chrome extension! Tired of switching between tabs and constantly searching for information? PopBoxGPT is here to revolutionize your browsing experience. This innovative Chrome extension offers quick access to a powerful AI language model right within your browser, making multitasking a breeze. The OpenAPI website charges in batches of 1000 tokens. According to their website 1000 tokens is approximately 750 words. Analytics and Reporting Retrieves, combines, and displays your store’s operational data. Examples: How many sales did I make this month? What are my 5 best sold items? Did my return rate decrease this year? Products, Orders and Customers Manages your store's product catalog, order, and customer information. Examples: Create product descriptions for products without one Update customer delivery address Create a new segment with customers that meet certain conditions Store Setup and Optimization Sets up, optimizes, and maintains your store’s functionalities and automations. Coming soon Examples: Is my store's checkout configured correctly? Add a new staff member to my store Display a Cookie Consent Manager for EU Countries Email and Communications Analyzes, writes and responds to customer inquiries via email. Coming soon Examples: Send a 10% discount code to new subscribers Notify John Harris about his delayed delivery Respond to all emails regarding delivery times The skills work together to enhance the experience Designed for Small-Medium Businesses Supports all eCommerce types and business models Type Model Business to Business Can manage orders, generate reports and handle client relationships. Business to Consumer Can manage inventory, track delivery, and facilitate customer engagement. Consumer to Consumer Can help navigate listings, update orders and provide customer support. Direct Sellers Traditional manufacturers and private-label businesses Subscription-Based Recurring digital service or physical product providers Dropshipping No-inventory intermediaries and resellers FAQs What you need to know about working with your AI Assistant Where is the data stored? While the data generated by your eCommerce platform is stored on its respective servers, the data generated by our AI system, such as conversation logs, updates, and automation flows, is securely stored on Amazon Web Services (AWS) servers. These servers are located in Europe and the United States, ensuring that your data is protected and managed in accordance with high security and privacy standards. What sets this assistant apart from others? What sets our AI Assistant apart from others is its specific focus on eCommerce. Unlike generic AI assistants, ours is meticulously designed and trained for eCommerce tasks. It understands the complexities of product management, order processing, and customer interaction, providing an unrivaled level of specialized support for online businesses. Our AI Assistant is also powered by a state-of-the-art language model, ensuring it can understand and generate human-like text, leading to more natural and effective interactions. Its advanced machine learning capabilities mean it can learn and adapt over time, improving its performance the more it's used. Can you purchase assistant skills separately? Yes, Assistant Skills can indeed be purchased separately. However, please note that availability and the exact process might depend on the active subscription plan you have with us. This flexibility allows you to customize the assistant's capabilities to better suit the specific needs of your eCommerce business. What happens if the assistant deletes something important? Our AI Assistant operates on a strict consent-based system. This means it will only delete or modify data when you explicitly instruct it to do so. Importantly, our system also includes a feature that allows you to undo changes made by the assistant. The timeframe in which you can revert these changes varies depending on your subscription plan. This ensures that even if something important is mistakenly deleted, you have the ability to restore it promptly. How much does it cost to use the AI Assistant? The cost of operating our AI Assistant is influenced by several factors. These include the cost of using the large language model (LLM) provided by OpenAI, the number of active skills the assistant possesses, the number of automations in use, and the volume of information transferred. As our product is currently in Beta, we are committed to maintaining transparency about usage and costs with our customers throughout our collaboration. Can I connect the assistant to a custom eCommerce platform? Currently, our AI Assistant supports a number of popular eCommerce platforms. While direct integration with custom eCommerce platforms isn't available at the moment, it's definitely on our roadmap! Stay tuned for updates on this feature. Can I teach new skills to my assistant? While the current version of our AI Assistant comes with a predefined set of skills, we're actively working to make it even better. The ability for you to teach your assistant new skills is indeed on our roadmap! Stay tuned for updates! Can I use the assistant and still be compliant with the GDPR or CCPA? Yes, the AI Assistant complies with regulations such as the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the US's California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). It has access only to the data that is authorized by the parties involved, and all conversations are stored securely, are easily accessible, and can be deleted upon request. It works great with your favourite messaging tools Coming soon Automate your store, today Why waste another minute doing mundane tasks when you can work with the best in the industry? Get started for free Our product is currently in LIMITED-ACCESS BETA. As we learn from our existing users and continue to improve our systems, we will roll out larger-scale access over the next months. A.I. Store Manager Headquartered in Vienna, Austria. Writee | Premium Document & Registration Services WRITEE . Services How it Works FAQs Contact Us Registrations & Document Services WRITEE Your Documentation. Our Responsibility. WhatsApp Us Request Home Visit Office Visit Home Service On-Call Support 100% Confidential Your data and documents are handled with top-tier security. Transparent Process No hidden fees. Track your request at every stage. Home Service We come to you. No need to stand in long queues. Fast Turnaround Priority processing with clear timelines communicated upfront. Everything documentation, under one roof We handle your paperwork with the same care a top professional firm would — minus the intimidation. Agreement Writing Services Legally sound drafting tailored to protect your interests, customized and printed directly onto official stamp paper. Rental & Lease Agreements Partnership & MOUs Employment Contracts Affidavits & Declarations Request Service Property Information Services Fast documentation retrieval and verification regarding land records, ownership transitions, and clear legal title paths. Encumbrance Certificates (EC) Adangal / 1B / ROR Records Property History & Violations Market Valuation Data Request Service Complaints & Petitions Drafting Professional drafting of official petitions, administrative complaints, and legal grievances addressed to regional bureaus. Revenue Petitions (Tahsildar/RDO) Cyber Crime Representations Consumer Dispute Complaints Police Grievances Request Service Notary & Affidavit Support Attestation and execution of standard personal affidavits and identity verifications via licensed legal networks. Gazette Name Change Forms Income & Residence Proofs Legal Heir Certificates Indemnity & Surety Bonds Request Service Fulfillment Pipeline From request to delivery in 5 steps 01 Choose Service Select from our range of documentation services. 02 Share Details Send your requirements via WhatsApp or Call. 03 Draft & Review Our experts prepare the draft for your approval. 04 Processing We print on official stamp paper and verify. 05 Delivery Receive completed documents at your doorstep. Premium On-Demand Your personal registrar, right at your doorstep. Why travel to a busy government registry office when we can come to you? Our certified document executives manage the secure transport, verification, stamp paper printing, and official processing from the comfort of your home. Book Home Visit Call Us Secure Doorstep Benefits Verified Officers Every field executive is background-checked and legally certified. Same-Day Processing We process and initiate legal drafts within 30 minutes of our visit. Zero Travel Required No traffic, no long SRO office queues, and no administrative friction. FAQS Questions we get often Can I get documents drafted without visiting the office? Yes. WRITEE offers a dedicated Home Service where an agent visits your location at a booked time slot. We also provide full WhatsApp support and on-call assistance so you can get your documentation done without ever leaving your home. How long does the documentation and registration support take? We pride ourselves on speed. For many of our core drafting and affidavit services, we offer a fast 15-30 minute processing time. Registration timelines depend on Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) slot availability, but we ensure priority processing at every step. Are my personal documents and details kept confidential? Absolutely. We guarantee 100% confidentiality. Your data, proofs, and property documents are handled with top-tier security and bank-grade professionalism. We never share your details with unauthorized third parties. Do you deliver the final stamp papers to my home? Yes! Once your document proof is verified and approved by you, we prepare the final documents on official stamp papers and deliver the physical originals safely to your doorstep. Where are WRITEE services currently available? We currently provide physical and home services across Vizianagaram, Bobbili, Salur, and all surrounding Mandals in Andhra Pradesh. Online and WhatsApp drafting support is available from anywhere. Are there any hidden fees or middleman charges? No. We operate with a strict zero-tolerance bribery policy (ఈ కార్యాలయంలో ఎటువంటి లంచాలు తీసుకోబడవు). Our prices are highly affordable, starting from just ₹99, and we maintain a 100% transparent process with no hidden fees. Still have questions? Ask on WhatsApp WRITEE . Premium omnichannel document execution and legal drafting platform built for absolute trust, transparency, and speed. evidence.title: The AI Platform for ECCs and PASPs | Aurelian
evidence.description: The AI platform for 911 dispatch centers. Aurelian supports telecommunicators before, during, and after every call so they can focus on real emergencies.
evidence.text:
The AI Platform for ECCs and PASPs | Aurelian Join Oregon public safety leaders on September 9th in Salem. Register for the Symposium → Solutions Customers Resources About Careers Login Get a Demo Solutions to help PSAPs Protect the communities they serve Aurelian is built to support PSAPs before, during, and after every call, so telecommunicators can deliver fast, consistent support. Request a demo 0 Calls handled by CORA and AVA Time 12:35:27 Date 09.09.2026 Built to support the entire operation The reality of the work Telecommunicators are expected to be perfect on every call, even as call volumes rise, staffing remains constrained, and systems grow more complex. Most technology addresses pieces of the problem. Aurelian is built to support the entire operation. 911 Calls 911 Calls Time Pressure Non-Emergency Queues 911 Calls Non-Emergency Queues SOP Compliance Increasing Call Volume Staffing Gaps Time Pressure 911 Calls Complex Calls SOP Compliance Increasing Call Volume Staffing Gaps Non-Emergency Queues Time Pressure Automation Where It Helps Designed around human judgment How Aurelian helps Aurelian uses automation with intention to protect PSAP time and space for the moments that matter. AVA answers non-emergency calls instantly, eliminating hold times Every call answered, immediately Call-takers can focus on emergencies Faster, more accurate records Self-healing continuously improves call routing learn more about Ava CORA provides real-time, context-aware guidance, without taking control Real-time guidance during emergencies Consistency in the moments that matter most Less cognitive load, better call handling Greater confidence during calls learn more about CORA Humans remain in control of emergencies and decision-making. Technology extends capacity, so call-takers can handle urgency. Live. Trusted. Deployed. Proven in the real world Aurelian is already operating inside PSAPs, supporting telecommunicators at scale, under real conditions. See how agencies are using the platform today. view all case studies purpose-built for your environment Designed to support your team Aurelian understands how your center operates. By learning your workflows, SOPs, and systems, Aurelian quietly and intentionally supports the full call flow: while keeping telecommunicators fully in control. 01 Non-emergency calls are handled without delay 02 Emergency calls are supported in real time 03 Information is captured and carried forward 04 Call-takers stay focused on emergency callers Shaped by your SOPs Built to fit your center Every center is different. Your technology should reflect that. Fits alongside existing CAD and phone systems Designed around real workflows Configurable to your SOPs How Aurelian supports your center’s operations Emergency communications will continue to evolve. Aurelian is built to evolve with them. A configurable platform that supports telecommunicators today and prepares PSAPs for what comes next. talk to our team Aurelian builds purpose-built technology for PSAPs, making every call better for telecommunicators and the communities they serve. A new generation of image creation and editing Released on September 8, 2026, GPT Image 2.5 improves editing consistency, infographic accuracy, layout control, and iteration speed. Image 2.5 brings those capabilities into a focused browser workflow for everyday visual production. 0 1 Create from text, images, or a sketch Begin with a written brief, one or more visual references, or a rough drawing. Define the subject, composition, materials, and intended use in one prompt. 0 2 Edit with more precision Change a setting, style, object, or composition while retaining more of the details that should stay recognizable. 0 3 Build clearer layouts and infographics Create visual hierarchy, spacing, callouts, and the information that matters. Text rendering is improved, but final copy still deserves review. 0 4 Iterate in a continuous conversation Refine an image across multiple turns, use reference images to guide the next version, and compare deliberate changes instead of restarting. Core capabilities Move from direction to a production-ready visual Use detailed prompts and references to preserve what matters, revise what does not, and shape each result for a real creative task. 1 Keep products coherent across a campaign Use a product reference to explore studio shots, lifestyle scenes, and new compositions while holding onto recognizable shape, materials, and label structure. 2 Preserve characters through a sequence Keep a character's face, wardrobe, proportions, and mood connected as pose, framing, and action change from one frame to the next. 3 Make a targeted edit without losing the scene Use a direct instruction or mask to isolate the change. Adjust color, material, background, or styling while preserving the useful parts of the source image. How Image 2.5 works Create or edit an image in four steps Choose the right model, provide a clear source, set the output, and refine the strongest result. 1 0 1 Choose Sunburst or Flare Use Sunburst when editing precision and maximum image quality matter most. Choose Flare for fast, high-quality everyday generation. 2 0 2 Add a prompt and visual references Start from text, upload images, or provide a sketch. Separate what should change from the details that must remain consistent. 3 0 3 Set size, quality, and format Choose automatic or custom dimensions, select a quality level, and use PNG, JPEG, or WebP with opaque or transparent backgrounds where supported. 4 0 4 Generate, inspect, and refine Review text, hands, materials, layout, and identity details. Stream partial previews where available, then refine the most important change. Creative use cases Put Image 2.5 to work across your visual pipeline Develop campaign assets, informational graphics, story frames, or precise image revisions from the same flexible workflow. 0 1 Product and campaign visuals Create coordinated product shots, launch concepts, ad variations, and social crops while keeping the key visual identity connected. 0 2 Infographics and structured layouts Turn a dense brief into a clearer visual hierarchy for explainers, presentations, posters, diagrams, and information-rich social posts. 0 3 Characters, scenes, and storyboards Develop a recurring subject across scenes and plan visual beats for comics, films, presentations, or narrative concepts. 0 4 Photo and design edits Replace a background, restyle a scene, recolor an object, extend a composition, or revise a selected area without remaking the whole image. Image 2.5 FAQ GPT Image 2.5 questions, answered Understand the model choices, inputs, output controls, editing workflow, and practical limitations before you create. 0 1 What is GPT Image 2.5? GPT Image 2.5 is OpenAI's image-generation and editing family released on September 8, 2026. It accepts text and image inputs and produces images through two variants: Sunburst and Flare. 0 2 What is the difference between Sunburst and Flare? Sunburst is the quality-first model for workflows where editing precision matters most. Flare is the fastest GPT Image 2.5 model for high-quality everyday generation. 0 3 Can Image 2.5 generate and edit images? Yes. Create a new image from a prompt, edit an existing image, use multiple images as references, or guide a targeted change with a mask. Multi-turn workflows let you continue refining the same visual direction. 0 4 Which sizes and formats does GPT Image 2.5 support? It supports recommended square, landscape, and portrait sizes plus custom dimensions up to 4K within documented limits. Output can be PNG, JPEG, or WebP, with transparent backgrounds available for PNG and WebP. 0 5 Which quality settings are available? GPT Image 2.5 supports low, medium, high, xhigh, max, and auto quality. Use lower quality for quick drafts and compare higher settings for final detail, latency, and cost. 0 6 How do I keep a character or product consistent? Use clear reference images, name the features that must stay recognizable, and keep each revision focused. GPT Image 2.5 improves detail retention during edits, though every result should still be reviewed. 0 7 How fast is GPT Image 2.5? Flare is optimized for speed, while Sunburst prioritizes editing precision and image quality. Complex prompts can still take up to two minutes, and partial-image streaming can provide progress previews. 0 8 Can I use generated images for commercial projects? Paid plans and credit packs support personal and commercial projects, subject to the terms of service and your rights to any uploaded source material. Review every output before publishing or delivery. What Is GPT Image 2.5? GPT Image 2.5 is an AI image generator and photo editor that turns written descriptions into images and changes existing photos through text instructions. Create a scene from scratch, replace a background, adjust lighting, or explore a different visual style without describing a series of manual editing steps. Use the GPT Image 2.5 generator to build from an idea or a reference photo. Improved subject retention helps familiar people, pets, and products remain recognizable in new settings, while more consistent editing lets you develop a preferred result through a series of focused changes. How to Use the GPT Image 2.5 Generator 1 Start with text or a photo Open the GPT Image 2.5 generator and choose your starting point. Describe a new image if you are beginning from an idea, or upload a photo when you want to change an existing scene. 2 Describe the result you want Tell GPT Image 2.5 what should appear, where it belongs, and how it should look. For an edit, name the requested change and the details you want to keep, such as the subject, framing, or clothing. 3 Generate and review Run your prompt in the GPT Image 2.5 generator. Review the subject, composition, and text once before continuing. Choose the version closest to your goal as the reference for your next change. 4 Refine one detail Use GPT Image 2.5 to build on that version. Ask for softer lighting, a different background, or revised object placement. Continue with the latest generated image as your reference so each edit starts from the creative choices you want to retain. Pro Tip: For a product edit, separate the change from the preservation request: âPlace the bottle on pale stone; keep the label, bottle shape, and camera angle.â This identifies the new setting and the product details to retain. Key Features of GPT Image 2.5 GPT Image 2.5 brings image creation and photo editing into a workflow built around written instructions. Start with the task you need done, then describe the scene or change in terms you already use. Generate Images from Text Turn a subject, setting, and style into a new image. The GPT Image 2.5 generator lets you describe a quiet interior, a colorful illustration, or a product scene without starting from an existing photo. Specify composition and lighting when those details matter to the result. Edit Photos with Written Instructions Upload a photo and name the part to change. GPT Image 2.5 follows focused editing instructions more reliably, helping retain surrounding details while you replace an object or revise its appearance. Specify the subject and composition you want to keep. Replace Backgrounds and Build New Scenes Place a familiar subject in a studio, on a tabletop, or outdoors. With GPT Image 2.5, improved reference fidelity helps carry distinctive features into the new setting. Describe the surface, perspective, and surrounding light to give the scene a coherent look. Adjust Lighting, Color, and Style Warmer light, richer textures, and more natural shading can change how a scene feels. ChatGPT Images 2.5 introduces these model improvements, which also support image creation here. Describe the lighting, palette, and subject details that matter to your intended look. Add or Revise Text in Images Ask GPT Image 2.5 to place a short headline in a poster or change wording in an existing image. Include the exact words and their intended position. Review spelling, spacing, and legibility in the output before using the image in a finished design. GPT Image 2.5 for Everyday Creative Projects GPT Image 2.5 fits both new ideas and changes to images you already have. Choose a starting point that matches the job: text for a new composition, or a reference photo for an edit. Product Images and Background Variations Use the GPT Image 2.5 generator to develop seasonal product visuals from one reference photo. Place a bottle on pale stone for a skincare promotion, then try a warm bathroom setting. Specify its shape, label, and proportions as details to retain across the variations. Posters and Social Graphics Posters and social graphics are useful applications of ChatGPT Images 2.5 capabilities. For your image here, describe an event, color palette, and headline position. Build a central illustration with space for the event name, then adapt the wording and colors for another announcement. Photo Restyling Turn a personal photo into an illustrated invitation, a painted portrait, or a stylized profile picture. GPT Image 2.5 can reinterpret the scene while better retaining distinctive subject features. Describe the final use and preferred style, including the expression or pose you want to retain. Character and Story Concepts Develop a character for a story, from a cafe scene to an outdoor adventure. ChatGPT Images 2.5 improves reference fidelity, helping recognizable features carry into new compositions. Use the same character reference here and specify the hairstyle, outfit, and illustration style that tie your scenes together. Targeted Changes to Existing Images Refresh an existing promotional image when the product, season, or message changes. Use GPT Image 2.5 to replace a prop or revise one part of the scene while retaining the overall composition. Build from the preferred version when you need another adjustment for the campaign. Get Better Results with ChatGPT Images 2.5 These prompt techniques apply to ChatGPT Images 2.5 and the generator on this page. Give each instruction a purpose: establish the scene, change one element, or arrange readable text. 0 1 Give a new scene three anchors. Start a GPT Image 2.5 generator prompt with the subject, setting, and look: âA ceramic mug on a pale oak table, soft window light.â Add camera angle or colors only when they matter to the image you need. 0 2 Separate one edit from what should stay. For an existing photo, tell GPT Image 2.5: âReplace the wall with a light gray background; keep the person and framing.â Use that result as the reference for your next lighting or background adjustment. 0 3 Make image text explicit. When writing prompts for ChatGPT Images 2.5 or this page, put âSummer Marketâ in quotation marks and specify its position. For several text blocks, describe their order and relative sizes to establish a clear reading hierarchy. Common Mistake: Asking for a watercolor, glossy photograph, and flat icon style in the same instruction gives conflicting directions. Pick one main look, then use light, color, and composition to refine it. GPT Image 2.5 FAQ How do I use GPT Image 2.5? Start the GPT Image 2.5 generator with a description for a new scene, or upload a photo when a specific subject matters. Name the result you want, generate an image, then use your preferred version as the reference for further changes. You can refine the lighting or background without restating the entire scene. Can GPT Image 2.5 edit an existing photo? Yes. Upload a photo to GPT Image 2.5 and describe the change. Its more precise editing helps retain surrounding details while you replace a background, change an object, or adjust lighting. Name what should stay. Exact preservation is not guaranteed, so check important product or subject details and lettering before publishing. What can I create with ChatGPT Images 2.5? ChatGPT Images 2.5 supports product visuals, illustrations, posters, social graphics, and photo edits. You can explore these tasks with the GPT Image 2.5 generator here using your own brief or reference photo. For a series, reuse a reference and specify the colors, subject details, and visual style that should connect the images. Is GPT Image 2.5 free to try? Yes. You can try GPT Image 2.5 with the free option offered on this page. Check the available allowance and current plan details before starting, especially if you want to generate several versions. Use the free option to explore a prompt or photo edit, then decide whether the available usage meets your needs. Free access does not imply unlimited use. Can GPT Image 2.5 add or change text in an image? Yes. GPT Image 2.5 can add a headline, revise wording, or arrange text within an image. Put the exact copy in quotation marks and describe its placement and relative size. These instructions also apply to ChatGPT Images 2.5. For a poster, separate the main title from dates and supporting details in your prompt. What image files should I upload? For GPT Image 2.5 editing, choose a clear source image with the subject and relevant details visible. The upload control shows which file types and sizes are accepted. Avoid starting from a heavily blurred or tightly cropped photo when the edit depends on a label, face, or object that is difficult to see. Is this an official OpenAI website? No. This is an independent website providing access to GPT Image 2.5, not an official OpenAI website. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI. Use the account and usage information on this site to understand how access works here; another serviceâs plan does not describe the allowance offered on this page. How GPT Image 2.5 Works The native multimodal architecture behind the GPT Image family, and the refinements that make 2.5 sharper, faster, and more precise in edits. Native Image Tokens GPT Image 2.5 draws an image the way a language model writes a sentence: inside one omni model, visual tokens are predicted in order alongside the text. Words, layout, and lighting are decided together, so type comes out spelled and placed right, never painted over random noise and cleaned up afterwards. Planning Before Pixels In Thinking mode a reasoning pass runs before the first pixel is rendered. The model reads the brief and the reference images, resolves composition, style, and text content, then checks its plan for conflicts. Long prompts survive intact, and a chain of edits leaves every approved region just where it was. Flare and Sunburst The 2.5 release ships as two API models on one base. Flare is the everyday engine: the same fidelity and editing gains at up to 50% lower latency than GPT Image 2. Sunburst spends longer per image for tighter control across edits. Both refine the final render so skin, fabric, and glass keep natural grain. FAQ Frequently Asked Questions About GPT Image 2.5 Have more questions? Contact us by email 1 What is GPT Image 2.5? GPT Image 2.5 is the next generation of OpenAI's GPT Image model family, released in September 2026 and available here as an online image generator and editor. It turns written prompts and reference images into finished visuals, and it is tuned for the details production work depends on: sharper detail, natural lighting and texture, subjects that stay recognizable, and edits that leave the rest of the image untouched. You can use it in the generator above without any setup. 2 How does GPT Image 2.5 improve on GPT Image 2? GPT Image 2 introduced reasoning before the render, reliable multilingual text, and batches of consistent images. GPT Image 2.5 refines that base in four areas: sharper detail with more natural lighting and richer texture, better preservation of the subjects in your reference photos, precision edits that change only what you asked for, and instructions that hold across multiple turns without quality loss. Generation is also up to 50% faster. 3 What can I generate with GPT Image 2.5? Anything from a single hero image to a coordinated set: marketing posters, product and packaging shots, UI and app mockups, presentation slides, comics and storyboards, infographics, and localized visuals with text in multiple languages. Text-to-image starts from a prompt; image-to-image takes up to 16 reference images, rough sketches included, to guide character, style, composition, or product details. 4 What resolutions and aspect ratios are supported? Output is available at 1K, 2K, and 4K. Aspect ratios include 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, and 3:4, plus an automatic option that lets the model choose the frame. The 1:1 ratio renders up to 2K, and the automatic ratio renders at 1K. Higher resolutions cost more credits per image, and the exact cost is shown in the generator before you run it. 5 Is GPT Image 2.5 the same as MAI-Image-2.5? No. MAI-Image-2.5 is a Microsoft image model available through OpenRouter and other providers. GPT Image 2.5 is powered by OpenAI and belongs to the GPT Image family, the same line as GPT Image 2 and GPT Image 1.5; in the API it ships as GPT-Image-2.5 Flare and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst. The shared version number causes confusion in search results, so check the vendor before comparing samples or pricing. 6 Do I need an account, and what does it cost? You can browse examples without signing in, and a free account includes starter credits to try GPT Image 2.5. Each generation deducts credits based on resolution, with 1K the cheapest and 4K the most expensive. Credits never expire. Paid plans add larger credit bundles, private generation, a commercial license, and priority support on the top tier. Every plan is listed in the pricing section on this page. MeeLang is a Chrome extension for real-time translation during Google Meet calls. It captures meeting audio from the browser tab, detects the spoken language, and displays translated subtitles as a floating overlay while people talk. The service supports more than 30 languages, including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Arabic, and Portuguese. Its context-aware translation is designed to follow fast, jargon-heavy conversation with sub-second latency. MeeLang also stores bilingual transcripts locally in the browser, where users can search, export, replay original audio, or delete records. Google Meet is supported today; Zoom Web, Microsoft Teams, and Webex are listed as upcoming integrations. A free plan includes 60 translation minutes monthly, while Pro provides 600 minutes and AI meeting summaries. MeeLang is a Chrome extension for real-time translation during Google Meet calls. It captures meeting audio from the browser tab, detects the spoken language, and displays translated subtitles as a floating overlay while people talk. The service supports more than 30 languages, including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Arabic, and Portuguese. Its context-aware translation is designed to follow fast, jargon-heavy conversation with sub-second latency. MeeLang also stores bilingual transcripts locally in the browser, where users can search, export, replay original audio, or delete records. Google Meet is supported today; Zoom Web, Microsoft Teams, and Webex are listed as upcoming integrations. A free plan includes 60 translation minutes monthly, while Pro provides 600 minutes and AI meeting summaries. Ask your question in plain language and our AI reader Yuna Mizuki shuffles the deck, lays a real spread, and walks you through every card's meaning — upright and reversed — in a conversation, not a static cheat sheet. Pull one card for a quick yes/no, use the Celtic Cross for life decisions, or try a compatibility spread to read your relationship. Daily tarot is free forever; pro spreads give you the depth of a paid in-person session, in your language, on any device. Frequently Asked Questions What is AI tarot reading? AI tarot reading uses a language model to interpret tarot cards in a conversation, the way a human reader would. Unmei Tarot shuffles a full 78-card deck, lays a real spread (Celtic Cross, three-card, compatibility, and more), and explains each card's meaning — upright or reversed — in the context of your specific question. Is Unmei Tarot really free? Yes. Daily one-card readings, the standard three-card spread, and most love and life spreads are free with no signup. Pro spreads like Celtic Cross, the 2026 Annual Forecast, and gesture-draw readings require a Pro membership. Are AI tarot readings accurate? Our AI reader follows the same interpretation traditions a human tarot reader uses — Rider-Waite-Smith meanings, positional context, and reversed nuances. How is this different from a free online tarot site? Most free sites show static card meanings. Unmei Tarot reads your specific question and gives a tailored interpretation per card and per position, with reasoning you can ask follow-up questions about — closer to a real sitting than a meaning lookup. How should I phrase my question? Open questions ("What should I know about my career right now?") work better than yes/no questions. If you do want a yes/no answer, use a one-card pull and frame it clearly. Avoid asking the same question repeatedly — the cards reflect the moment you ask. Do you use reversed cards? Yes. Cards can appear upright or reversed, and reversed meanings are interpreted in context — usually as blocked energy, an inward expression, or a need for caution — rather than as a strict opposite. Which tarot spread should I choose? For a quick yes/no or daily check-in, pull one card. For a past-present-future view, use the three-card spread. For relationships, use compatibility or reconciliation. For complex life decisions, the Celtic Cross gives the fullest picture. Is my reading private? Your questions and readings are tied to your account and never shared. Anonymous readings aren't stored beyond your current session. See our privacy policy for full details. ## Interpretation and Definitions

### Interpretation

Words with capitalized initial letters have meanings defined under the following conditions. The following definitions shall have the same meaning regardless of whether they appear in singular or plural form.

### Definitions

For the purposes of this Privacy Policy:

- **Account** means a unique account created for you to access our Service or parts of our Service.
- **Company** (referred to as either "the Company", "We", "Us" or "Our" in this Agreement) refers to Unmei Tarot.
- **Cookies** are small files placed on your computer, mobile device, or any other device by a website, containing the details of your browsing history on that website among its many uses.
- **Country** refers to: Japan.
- **Device** means any device that can access the Service such as a computer, a cellphone, or a digital tablet.
- **Personal Data** is any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual.
- **Service** refers to the Website.
- **Service Provider** means any natural or legal person who processes the data on behalf of the Company.
- **Usage Data** refers to data collected automatically, either generated by the use of the Service or from the Service infrastructure itself (for example, the duration of a page visit).
- **Website** refers to Unmei Tarot, accessible from [https://www.unmei-tarot.com](https://www.unmei-tarot.com).
- **You** means the individual accessing or using the Service, or the company, or other legal entity on behalf of which such individual is accessing or using the Service, as applicable.

## Collecting and Using Your Personal Data

### Types of Data Collected

#### Personal Data

While using our Service, we may ask you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you. Personally identifiable information may include, but is not limited to:

- Email address
- First name and last name
- Usage Data

#### Usage Data

Usage Data is collected automatically when using the Service.

Usage Data may include information such as your device's Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address), browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers, and other diagnostic data.

## Tracking Technologies and Cookies

We use Cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our Service and store certain information. Tracking technologies used are beacons, tags, and scripts to collect and track information and to improve and analyze our Service.

Cookies can be "Persistent" or "Session" Cookies. Persistent Cookies remain on your personal computer or mobile device when you go offline, while Session Cookies are deleted as soon as you close your web browser.

## Use of Your Personal Data

The Company may use Personal Data for the following purposes:

- **To provide and maintain our Service**, including to monitor the usage of our Service.
- **To manage your Account:** to manage your registration as a user of the Service.
- **To contact you:** To contact you by email, telephone calls, SMS, or other equivalent forms of electronic communication regarding updates or informative communications related to the functionalities, products, or contracted services.
- **To manage your requests:** To attend to and manage your requests to us.
- **For other purposes:** We may use your information for other purposes, such as data analysis, identifying usage trends, determining the effectiveness of our promotional campaigns, and to evaluate and improve our Service, products, marketing, and your experience.

## Retention of Your Personal Data

The Company will retain your Personal Data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use your Personal Data to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations (for example, if we are required to retain your data to comply with applicable laws), resolve disputes, and enforce our legal agreements and policies.

Instead of returning a static card meaning, it shuffles a full 78-card Rider-Waite-Smith deck, lays an actual spread for the question you asked, and interprets each card by its position and orientation — upright or reversed — the way a human reader would. You can then ask follow-up questions in conversation rather than starting over. Spreads cover daily guidance, love and reconciliation, compatibility, career direction, either-or decisions, and full professional layouts including Celtic Cross, Horseshoe and Hexagram. A 16-card annual forecast breaks the year ahead down month by month and by category. Start by describing a situation in ordinary language, then bring tarot into the discussion when cards add useful information. The service supports focused spreads, complete-deck draws, card positions, orientations, and interpretation of the cards actually shown. You can arrange cards drawn from a physical deck or use TaroTown’s in-chat draw flow. Signed-in conversations continue across sessions, while memory controls separately govern long-term collection and reader access to stored context. Temporary conversations do not update long-term memory. TaroTown frames readings as interpretation and self-reflection, not guaranteed predictions or professional advice.
